batch_01.json::Thai Green Chicken Curry.title: Thai green chicken curry
quick_steps: Slice the chicken, dice the aubergine into 2 cm cubes, and trim the green beans and slice the capsicum.
Heat the oil and 3 tbsp thick coconut cream from the tin in a saucepan over medium heat. Fry the curry paste 2–3 minutes until aromatic.
Stir in the remaining coconut milk and stock, then add the lime leaves, chicken and aubergine. Simmer gently 10–12 minutes until the aubergine softens.
Add the green beans and capsicum and simmer 4–6 minutes until just tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar until savoury, lightly sweet and fragrant. Turn off the heat and fold in the Thai basil.
Serve straight away over steamed jasmine rice with lime wedges.

batch_01.json::Classic Beef Lasagne.title: Classic beef lasagne
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Cook the pancetta for 3 minutes, then soften the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes.
Brown the mince, then stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce the wine by half, then add the tomatoes and stock. Simmer uncovered for 40–45 minutes until thick but spoonable. Season with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat, whisk in the flour for 1–2 minutes, then whisk in the milk. Simmer 5–7 minutes until thick enough to coat a spoon. Add the nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Layer ragù, lasagne sheets, béchamel and some Parmesan in a baking dish, finishing with béchamel, Parmesan and mozzarella.
Bake covered with foil for 25 minutes, then uncovered for 15–20 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest for 15 minutes before slicing.

stages.title: Cook the ragù base
steps: Heat olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Cook pancetta for 3 minutes, then add onion, carrot and celery and soften for 8 minutes.
Add mince and brown thoroughly, breaking up lumps; stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute.

stages.title: Simmer the meat sauce
steps: Pour in wine and reduce by half, scraping up any browned bits. Add tomatoes and stock.
Simmer uncovered for 40–45 minutes until thick but spoonable, stirring occasionally; season with salt and pepper.

stages.title: Make the béchamel
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat; whisk in flour and cook for 1–2 minutes without browning.
Gradually whisk in milk and simmer 5–7 minutes until smooth and thick enough to coat a spoon. Add nutmeg, salt and pepper.

stages.title: Layer the lasagne
steps: Heat oven to 190°C conventional (170°C fan). Spread a thin layer of ragù in a 23 x 33 cm baking dish.
Layer pasta sheets, ragù, béchamel and a little Parmesan; repeat, finishing with béchamel, Parmesan and mozzarella. Check packet instructions for dried sheets.

stages.title: Bake and rest
steps: Cover loosely with foil and bake 25 minutes; remove foil and bake another 15–20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
Rest for 15 minutes before slicing so the layers hold together.

batch_01.json::Chicken Tikka Masala.title: Chicken tikka masala
quick_steps: Mix the yoghurt, lemon juice, half the garlic and ginger, half the garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, paprika and salt. Coat the chicken and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat half the oil in a wide heavy pan over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken in batches, 2–3 minutes per side, until lightly charred.

Lower to medium and add the remaining oil and onion. Cook 6–8 minutes until soft and golden, then add the remaining garlic, ginger and spices, including the chilli powder, for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the crushed tomatoes and 100 ml water, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer 10–12 minutes until slightly thickened, blending if you want it smooth.
Stir in the cream, chicken and any juices. Simmer gently 8–12 minutes until the thickest piece reaches 75°C, then season and serve with rice and coriander.

batch_01.json::Shakshuka.title: Shakshuka
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide lidded frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and capsicum for 8–10 minutes until soft and the onion is translucent.
Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and chilli flakes. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, without scorching the garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes with the salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered for 10–12 minutes until thick enough to hold shallow wells, then adjust the seasoning.
Make six wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook over low heat for 5–8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are done how you like them.
Scatter with parsley or coriander and serve from the pan with crusty bread.

batch_01.json::Spaghetti Bolognese.title: Spaghetti bolognese
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a heavy-based pot over medium-low heat. Cook the pancetta for 4–5 minutes until its fat renders, then add the onion, carrot and celery and cook 8–10 minutes until soft, not browned.
Turn the heat to medium, add the beef mince and break it up. Cook until the pink is gone and the liquid has evaporated, with a little browning.
Pour in the white wine, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer until almost completely evaporated, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the passata and 150 ml of the stock or water, season lightly and bring to a very gentle simmer. Partially cover and cook for about 100 minutes, adding a splash of water if it dries out.
Stir in the milk and simmer gently for 25–30 minutes until the meat is tender and the sauce thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente, reserving a cup of pasta water. Toss with the ragù and a splash of pasta water, then serve with the Parmigiano Reggiano.

batch_01.json::Greek Salad.title: Greek salad
quick_steps: Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumber into thick half-moons. Thinly slice the red onion and capsicum, soaking the onion in cold water for 5 minutes if you want a milder bite.
Whisk the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano and a pinch of pepper. Taste and add salt only if needed, as the feta and olives are salty.
Gently toss the vegetables and olives with the dressing in a broad serving bowl.
Top with the feta in large pieces, scatter over a little extra oregano and serve immediately.

batch_01.json::Classic Chocolate Brownie.title: Chocolate brownies
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (155°C fan) and line a 20 cm square tin with baking paper, leaving some overhang.
Melt the butter and dark chocolate together over very low heat until smooth, then let cool until warm rather than hot.
Whisk the eggs and caster sugar for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then stir in the vanilla.
Fold in the chocolate mixture, then sift in the flour, cocoa and salt. Mix until no dry streaks remain.
Spread into the tin and bake for 24–30 minutes, until the edges are set, the centre has a slight wobble and a skewer shows moist crumbs.
Cool completely in the tin, then lift out and cut into nine squares.

batch_01.json::Lemon Drizzle Cake.title: Lemon drizzle cake
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Grease and line a 900 g loaf tin, then finely zest both lemons.
Beat the butter and caster sugar for 3–4 minutes until pale and fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, adding a spoonful of flour if it curdles.
Gently fold in the flour and lemon zest, then add the milk until the batter drops slowly from a spoon. Spoon into the tin and level.
Bake for 40–50 minutes until golden, springy and a skewer comes out clean. Cover loosely with foil for the last 10 minutes if browning too fast.
Mix the lemon juice with the granulated sugar until combined but still slightly grainy. Prick the warm cake all over, spoon over the drizzle and cool in the tin before slicing.

batch_01.json::Fluffy Buttermilk Pancake.title: Fluffy buttermilk pancakes
quick_steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a large bowl. In a jug, whisk the eggs, buttermilk, cooled melted butter and vanilla.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and fold gently until no large pockets of flour remain. Small lumps are fine. Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium-low heat and grease lightly with butter or oil. Spoon in about 60 ml batter per pancake.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form and the edges look set. Flip once and cook 1–2 minutes more until golden and cooked through.
Keep cooked pancakes warm on a rack in a low oven while you finish the batch.
Serve warm with maple syrup, berries and yoghurt, if using.

batch_01.json::Chicken Caesar Salad.title: Chicken Caesar salad
quick_steps: Toss the bread cubes with 2 tbsp of the olive oil, salt and pepper. Bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 8–10 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper and rub with the remaining olive oil. Sear in a frying pan over medium heat for 5–6 minutes per side, until the centre reaches 75°C.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then slice.
Mash the anchovies with the garlic and mustard. Whisk in the egg yolk (or mayonnaise) and lemon juice, then slowly whisk in the 60 ml olive oil until creamy. Season to taste.
Tear the washed and dried romaine into bite-sized pieces. Toss with the dressing, then top with the chicken, croutons and Parmesan.

batch_01.json::Garlic Butter Roast Potat.title: Garlic butter roast potatoes
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Cut the potatoes into 4–5 cm pieces and boil in well-salted water for 8–10 minutes until the edges just soften. Drain well.
Return the potatoes to the hot pot and shake to rough up the edges. Leave uncovered for 3–5 minutes to steam dry.
Heat the olive oil in a large roasting tray in the oven for 5 minutes. Add the potatoes in a single layer and turn to coat.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning halfway, until deeply golden and crisp.
Melt the butter with the garlic and rosemary in a small pan over low heat for 2 minutes, without browning the garlic.
Toss the potatoes in the garlic butter and roast for 5 more minutes until sizzling and glossy. Season with the salt and pepper.

batch_02.json::Vegetable Pad Thai.title: Vegetable pad Thai
quick_steps: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until flexible but still firm, then drain. Stir the tamarind, fish or soy sauce and brown sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the cubed, pressed tofu until golden on several sides, then push it to the edge.
Crack the eggs into the clear part of the pan and scramble until just set.
Add the noodles, julienned carrots and sauce. Toss until the noodles soften and absorb the sauce, adding a splash of water if needed.
Fold in the bean sprouts and sliced spring onions for the final minute so they stay crunchy.
Serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime wedges for squeezing.

batch_02.json::Teriyaki Salmon Bowls.title: Teriyaki salmon bowls
quick_steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook on medium heat as directed on the packet. Rest covered off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff.
Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, honey, rice vinegar, ginger and grated garlic together for the glaze.
Slice the cucumber and shred the carrots, then keep them chilled until serving.
Sear the patted-dry salmon skin-side down in a lightly oiled nonstick pan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes. Turn and cook until opaque and flaking.
Add the glaze and bubble briefly until glossy and the salmon is cooked through.
Divide the rice between bowls, add the cucumber and carrots, then top with salmon, glaze and sesame seeds.

stages.title: Cook the rice
steps: Rinse rice until the water runs mostly clear, then cook over medium heat with the amount of water directed on the packet.
Keep covered off the heat for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork.

stages.title: Mix the glaze and vegetables
steps: Whisk soy sauce, mirin, honey, vinegar, ginger and grated garlic together.
Slice cucumber and shred carrots; keep them chilled until serving.

stages.title: Cook and glaze the salmon
steps: Pat salmon dry and sear skin-side down in a lightly oiled nonstick pan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes.
Turn, cook until the thickest part is opaque and flakes easily, then add the glaze and bubble briefly until glossy; ensure fish is cooked through.

stages.title: Assemble the bowls
steps: Divide rice between bowls and add cucumber and carrots.
Top with salmon, spoon over reduced glaze and finish with sesame seeds.

batch_02.json::Beef Stroganoff.title: Beef stroganoff
quick_steps: Pat the beef dry and season with salt. Sear in batches in the oil in a wide pan over high heat, about 1 minute per side until browned, then set aside.
Reduce to medium, melt the butter and soften the sliced onion for 4 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until their moisture evaporates and the edges are golden. Stir in the paprika and flour for 1 minute.
Stir in the stock, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer until lightly thickened. Reduce to low and fold in the mustard and sour cream without boiling.
Cook the egg noodles in salted water until tender, then drain.
Return the beef and its juices to the sauce for 1–2 minutes, just until heated through. Serve over the noodles.

batch_01.json::Mushroom Risotto.title: Mushroom risotto
quick_steps: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms in batches until golden and the moisture has evaporated, season lightly with salt and pepper, then set aside.
In a heavy saucepan, warm the remaining oil and half the butter. Cook the onion gently for 4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the rice and stir for 2 minutes until the grains are glossy and slightly translucent at the edges.
Pour in the wine until nearly absorbed. Add the warm stock a ladle at a time at a gentle simmer for 18-22 minutes, until the rice is tender with a slight bite.
Fold in the mushrooms, adding a little more stock if it looks stiff. Off the heat, stir in the remaining butter, Parmesan and parsley, cover for 2 minutes, then serve.

batch_02.json::Chicken Parmesan.title: Chicken parmesan
quick_steps: Warm 1 tbsp of the olive oil in a saucepan over low heat. Cook the garlic for 30 seconds without browning, then add the passata, oregano and salt. Simmer until slightly thickened.
Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into two cutlets and pat dry. Coat each in flour, then beaten eggs, then panko mixed with parmesan, pressing the crumbs on firmly.
Heat the remaining oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Fry the cutlets in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until golden, then lay them in a baking dish.
Spoon sauce over each cutlet, leaving crisp edges showing, and scatter with mozzarella. Bake at 200°C until the cheese bubbles and the chicken reaches 74°C in the centre. Rest for 3 minutes.

batch_02.json::Chicken Fajitas.title: Chicken fajitas
quick_steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and red onion into thin strips. Toss the chicken with half the olive oil, paprika, cumin, oregano, salt and lime zest.
Heat the remaining oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook the peppers and onion in batches until lightly charred but still with some bite.
Move the vegetables to a plate. Cook the chicken in a single layer over high heat, turning, until golden and 74°C in the thickest pieces.
Return the vegetables to the pan and squeeze over the lime juice.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or in foil in the oven. Serve the filling with sour cream and sliced avocado.

batch_02.json::Roast Chicken with Lemon.title: Roast chicken with lemon
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Pat the chicken dry, rub with olive oil, thyme, salt and pepper, then put the halved lemon and garlic in the cavity.
Spread the quartered onions in a roasting tray and sit the chicken on top, breast-side up. Pour the stock around the chicken, not over it.
Roast for 75–90 minutes, until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 74°C and the skin is golden.
Rest the chicken under loose foil for 15 minutes, then carve and spoon over the strained roasting juices.

batch_02.json::Prawn Linguine with Chill.title: Prawn linguine with chilli
quick_steps: Boil the linguine in salted water until just short of al dente. Reserve a mug of pasta water, then drain. Thinly slice the garlic and chilli.
Pat the prawns dry. Sear them in 1 tbsp oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat until pink and opaque, then remove.
Lower to medium-low heat and add the remaining oil, garlic and chilli. Cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook until softened. Pour in the wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of reserved water until the sauce turns glossy and coats the strands.
Return the prawns briefly. Finish with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and the parsley, then serve.

batch_02.json::Lamb Kofta with Yoghurt.title: Lamb kofta with yoghurt
quick_steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out the liquid. Mix with the lamb mince, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, parsley and 1 tsp salt.
Shape the mixture into 8 short oval patties, by hand or around skewers.
Mix the Greek yoghurt with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and a pinch of salt. Fold in half the diced cucumber.
Heat the olive oil in a griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the kofta, turning, for about 10 minutes, until browned all over and cooked through to 71°C.
Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan until pliable. Serve the kofta with the yoghurt, remaining cucumber, extra parsley and lemon wedges.

batch_02.json::Classic Fish Tacos.title: Classic fish tacos
quick_steps: Shred the red cabbage and slice the red onion. Toss with the juice of one lime, a pinch of salt and the coriander, then leave to stand.
Pat the fish dry, cut into broad strips and coat with the paprika, cumin, olive oil and salt.
Cook the fish in a nonstick pan over high heat for 3–4 minutes per side, until opaque and flaking easily.
Mash the avocado with a squeeze of lime and salt. Stir the Greek yoghurt with the remaining lime juice and a tablespoon of water until spoonable.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat until flexible. Fill with fish, slaw, avocado and lime yoghurt, and serve straight away.

batch_02.json::Chickpea and Spinach Curr.title: Chickpea and spinach curry
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a deep pan over medium heat. Soften the chopped onion until golden at the edges, then add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer until thickened and the oil starts to separate.
Add the drained chickpeas, coconut milk and 100 ml water. Simmer gently for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach by handfuls until wilted, then season with salt and lemon juice. Simmer until the sauce coats the chickpeas.
Rest off the heat for a few minutes, then serve with basmati rice or warm flatbread.

batch_02.json::Creamy Mushroom Pasta.title: Creamy mushroom pasta
quick_steps: Boil the fettuccine in well-salted water until al dente. Reserve 200 ml of the cooking water, then drain.
Slice the mushrooms and cook in the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, in batches, until golden and the moisture has evaporated.
Add the butter and shallot and cook until softened. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in the cream and simmer gently. Stir in the parmesan and a little pasta water until smooth, without boiling hard.
Toss the pasta through the sauce until evenly coated, loosening with more pasta water if needed.
Finish with the parsley, lemon juice and black pepper.

stages.title: Cook pasta
steps: Boil fettuccine in well-salted water until al dente.
Reserve 200 ml cooking water before draining.

stages.title: Brown the mushrooms
steps: Slice mushrooms and cook in a large pan with oil over medium-high heat in batches, until golden brown.
Let their moisture evaporate before stirring often; add butter and shallot once browned.

stages.title: Make the cream sauce
steps: Add minced garlic for 30 seconds, then pour in cream and simmer gently.
Stir in grated parmesan and a little pasta water until smooth; avoid a hard boil.

stages.title: Toss and serve
steps: Add pasta and toss vigorously until evenly coated, loosening with more pasta water as needed.
Finish with parsley, lemon juice and black pepper.

batch_02.json::Honey Soy Chicken Thighs.title: Honey soy chicken thighs
quick_steps: Whisk the soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, garlic and ginger. Set a little aside in a clean bowl for finishing.
Pat the chicken dry. Heat the oil in an oven-safe pan over medium-high heat and brown the thighs 3–4 minutes per side.
Pour the glaze around the chicken and roast at 190°C, turning once, until the chicken reaches 74°C.
If the juices are thin, stir the cornflour with a tablespoon of cold water into them to thicken.
Cook the rice to packet directions while the chicken roasts.
Slice the chicken and serve over the rice with the pan juices and sliced spring onions.

batch_02.json::Eggplant Parmigiana.title: Eggplant parmigiana
quick_steps: Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm slices, salt them and rest for 10 minutes. Pat dry and brush both sides with olive oil.
Roast the slices in a single layer at 220°C, in batches, until soft and golden, turning halfway.
Meanwhile, cook the garlic in a little oil in a pan over medium heat for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the passata and simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the basil.
Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan in a baking dish, finishing with cheese.
Bake at 190°C until bubbling and golden, then rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

stages.title: Prepare eggplant
steps: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1 cm slices, sprinkle lightly with salt and rest for 10 minutes.
Pat dry and brush both sides lightly with olive oil.

stages.title: Roast the slices
steps: Arrange eggplant in a single layer on baking trays and roast at 220°C until soft and golden, turning halfway.
Work in batches if needed to avoid steaming.

stages.title: Make the sauce
steps: While eggplant roasts, cook minced garlic in a little oil over medium heat for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add passata, simmer until slightly thickened and stir in torn basil.

stages.title: Layer and bake
steps: Spread a thin layer of sauce in a baking dish, then alternate eggplant, sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Finish with cheese and bake at 190°C until bubbling and golden; rest 10 minutes before slicing.

batch_02.json::Spinach and Ricotta Canne.title: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni
quick_steps: Wilt the spinach in a pan over medium heat until soft. Cool, squeeze dry, chop finely and mix with ricotta, egg, half the parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add passata and a splash of water, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a baking dish. Pipe the filling into the dry cannelloni tubes and arrange them in a single layer.
Cover with the remaining sauce, then top with mozzarella and the remaining parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 10–15 minutes more until the pasta is tender and bubbling.

stages.title: Make the filling
steps: Wilt spinach in a pan, cool slightly and squeeze out as much liquid as possible.
Chop finely and mix with ricotta, egg, half the parmesan, nutmeg, salt and pepper.

stages.title: Prepare the tomato sauce
steps: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and cook garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant, without browning.
Add passata with a splash of water and simmer for 5 minutes; spread a thin layer in a baking dish.

stages.title: Fill and arrange
steps: Spoon ricotta filling into a piping bag or sturdy food bag with the corner snipped.
Pipe into dry cannelloni tubes and arrange in a single layer over sauce.

stages.title: Bake until tender
steps: Cover tubes completely with remaining sauce and sprinkle mozzarella and parmesan over the top.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes; uncover and bake 10–15 minutes until pasta is tender and bubbling.

batch_02.json::Chicken Noodle Soup.title: Chicken noodle soup
quick_steps: Dice the onion, carrots and celery. Cook in the olive oil in a soup pot over medium heat for about 8 minutes until softened, adding the garlic for the last 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock, add the bay leaf and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the chicken thighs and poach for 15–20 minutes, until cooked through (74°C).
Shred the chicken with two forks and return it to the pot. Add the egg noodles and simmer until tender, following the packet.
Remove the bay leaf and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice. Serve hot, scattered with parsley.

batch_02.json::Turkey Meatballs in Tomat.title: Turkey meatballs in tomato sauce
quick_steps: Combine the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, one minced garlic clove, parsley and a pinch of salt. Shape into 16 balls with damp hands.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Brown the meatballs for about 5 minutes until golden, then set aside.
In the same pan, soften the onion and remaining garlic for about 5 minutes. Add the passata and 100 ml water.
Return the meatballs, cover loosely and simmer for 15–20 minutes until cooked through to 74°C.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserving a little pasta water. Toss with the sauce, top with meatballs and extra parmesan.

stages.title: Mix and shape meatballs
steps: Combine turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, one minced garlic clove, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Mix gently and shape into 16 equal balls with damp hands; avoid packing too tightly.

stages.title: Brown the meatballs
steps: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Brown meatballs on several sides until golden, about 5 minutes, without fully cooking them; remove to a plate.

stages.title: Simmer in sauce
steps: Soften chopped onion and remaining garlic in the same pan for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent, then add passata and 100 ml water.
Return meatballs, cover loosely and simmer until cooked through to 74°C, about 15–20 minutes.

stages.title: Cook pasta and serve
steps: Boil spaghetti until al dente and reserve a little pasta water.
Toss with tomato sauce, top with meatballs and finish with extra parmesan.

batch_02.json::Korean Beef Bibimbap.title: Beef bibimbap
quick_steps: Cook the rice following the packet directions and keep it covered. Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil and brown sugar through the beef mince.
Julienne the carrots and courgette. Wilt the spinach in a pan over medium heat until just soft, then squeeze dry.
Cook the carrots and courgette separately in the neutral oil over medium heat for 2–3 minutes each, until just tender.
Brown the beef in a hot pan over high heat, breaking up lumps, until cooked through. Fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Divide the rice among four bowls and arrange the beef and vegetables on top. Add the eggs, sesame seeds and gochujang, then mix before eating.

stages.title: Cook rice and season beef
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to packet directions; keep covered until serving.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil and sugar in a bowl, then stir into beef mince.

stages.title: Prepare vegetables
steps: Julienne carrots and courgette; wilt spinach briefly in a pan over medium heat and squeeze dry.
Cook each vegetable separately in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes so colours and textures remain distinct.

stages.title: Cook beef and eggs
steps: Brown seasoned beef in a hot pan, breaking up lumps, until thoroughly cooked.
Fry eggs to your preferred doneness; cook yolks fully if serving someone at higher risk from undercooked eggs.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Divide rice among four bowls and arrange beef and vegetables in separate sections.
Top with eggs, sesame seeds and a small spoonful of gochujang; mix before eating.

batch_02.json::Baked Macaroni and Cheese.title: Baked macaroni and cheese
quick_steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet directions, then drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in the flour and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Gradually whisk in the milk and simmer until thick enough to coat a spoon.
Off the heat, stir in the Dijon mustard, grated cheddar and gruyere.
Fold the macaroni through the sauce, tip into a lightly buttered baking dish and scatter over the panko mixed with the parmesan.
Bake at 190°C until bubbling at the edges and golden on top, then rest for 5 minutes.

batch_02.json::Lentil Shepherd's Pie.title: Lentil shepherd's pie
quick_steps: Simmer the peeled, cubed potatoes in salted water until easily pierced with a fork. Drain and mash with the butter, milk and salt until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Soften the onion and carrots for 5 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook until their moisture has evaporated. Stir in the tomato paste and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the drained lentils and stock, then simmer uncovered until thick and spoonable. Season with salt and pepper and transfer to a baking dish.
Spread the mash over the filling and rough up the surface with a fork. Bake at 200°C until bubbling and lightly browned, then rest for 5 minutes.

stages.title: Make the potato topping
steps: Peel and cube potatoes, cover with cold salted water and simmer until easily pierced with a fork.
Drain thoroughly and mash with butter, milk and salt until smooth; set aside.

stages.title: Cook the vegetable base
steps: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat and soften diced onion and carrots for 5 minutes.
Add chopped mushrooms and cook until their moisture has evaporated; stir in tomato paste and thyme for 1 minute.

stages.title: Simmer the filling
steps: Drain lentils and add with vegetable stock; simmer uncovered until thick and spoonable.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper; transfer to a baking dish.

stages.title: Top and bake
steps: Spread mashed potato over the lentils and rough up the surface with a fork to create crisp ridges.
Bake at 200°C until bubbling and lightly browned; rest 5 minutes before serving.

batch_02.json::Greek Chicken Souvlaki.title: Greek chicken souvlaki
quick_steps: Cut the chicken into 3 cm pieces and toss with olive oil, juice of one lemon, two minced garlic cloves, oregano, paprika and salt. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, then skewer.
Grate the cucumber and squeeze out moisture. Stir into the yoghurt with the remaining garlic, a little lemon juice and salt, then chill.
Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high and oil it. Cook the skewers for 10–12 minutes, turning, until charred and the chicken reaches 74°C.
Warm the pita and slice the tomatoes. Fill the pita with chicken, tomatoes, tzatziki and lemon wedges.

stages.title: Marinate the chicken
steps: Cut chicken into even 3 cm pieces and toss with olive oil, juice of one lemon, two minced garlic cloves, oregano, paprika and salt.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes if time allows; thread onto skewers just before cooking.

stages.title: Prepare tzatziki
steps: Grate cucumber, squeeze out moisture and stir into yoghurt with remaining garlic and a little lemon juice.
Season with salt and chill until serving.

stages.title: Grill the skewers
steps: Heat a grill pan or barbecue to medium-high for about 3 minutes, until hot, and lightly oil the surface.
Cook skewers for 10–12 minutes, turning regularly, until charred in spots and chicken reaches 74°C.

stages.title: Serve in pita
steps: Warm pita briefly and slice tomatoes.
Slide chicken from skewers into pita with tomatoes, tzatziki and lemon wedges.

batch_02.json::Spanish Tortilla.title: Spanish tortilla
quick_steps: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes and onion. Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper in a large bowl until just combined.
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Cook the potatoes and onion gently until completely tender but not browned, then drain off most of the oil.
Fold the warm potato mixture into the eggs and rest for 3 minutes.
Cook in a lightly oiled nonstick pan over low heat until the edges set and the centre is mostly firm.
Invert onto a plate, slide back into the pan and cook until set through. Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

batch_02.json::Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fr.title: Beef and broccoli stir-fry
quick_steps: Cook the rice on low heat to the packet instructions until tender, and keep it covered.
Whisk the soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornflour, sesame oil and water until smooth. Thinly slice the beef rump across the grain.
Blanch the broccoli florets in boiling water on high heat for 90 seconds, then drain well.
Heat the neutral oil in a wok over high heat until very hot. Sear the beef in batches for 1–2 minutes until browned but still tender, then set aside.
Add the garlic and ginger for 20 seconds, then the broccoli and sauce. Simmer until glossy and thickened, return the beef briefly and serve over the rice.

batch_02.json::Roasted Vegetable Couscou.title: Roasted vegetable couscous
quick_steps: Cut the courgette, red pepper, eggplant and red onion into bite-sized pieces. Toss with the olive oil, cumin and salt.
Roast at 210°C for 25 minutes, turning halfway, until caramelised at the edges.
Put the couscous and raisins in a heatproof bowl and pour over the boiling vegetable stock. Cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Fold the roasted vegetables through the couscous with the lemon zest and juice.
Scatter over the chopped mint and season to taste while warm.

batch_02.json::Turkey and Avocado Wraps.title: Turkey and avocado wraps
quick_steps: Mash the avocados with lemon juice and a pinch of salt. In a separate bowl, stir the Dijon mustard into the Greek yoghurt for the dressing.
Wash and dry the lettuce, slice the tomatoes and grate the carrot.
Spread the avocado over the centre of each tortilla, leaving a border. Layer on the lettuce, turkey, tomato and carrot, then drizzle with the dressing.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly from the bottom. Cut diagonally with a sharp knife and serve straight away.

batch_02.json::Tuna and White Bean Salad.title: Tuna and white bean salad
quick_steps: Drain, rinse and pat dry the cannellini beans. Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and slice the red onion as thinly as possible.
Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, salt and pepper until lightly emulsified. Taste and adjust the acidity.
Drain the tuna, flake it into large pieces and gently fold it through the beans and vegetables.
Add the dressing and parsley, tossing just enough to coat without crushing the beans.

batch_02.json::Tomato and Red Pepper Sou.title: Tomato and red pepper soup
quick_steps: Halve the tomatoes, deseed the red peppers and cut the onion into wedges. Toss on a tray with the unpeeled garlic and olive oil.
Roast at 210°C for about 25 minutes, until softened and lightly charred.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins and blend with the roasted vegetables, stock and smoked paprika until smooth, working in batches.
Pour into a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes, until steaming hot.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in the cream and torn basil just before serving.

stages.title: Roast the vegetables
steps: Halve tomatoes, deseed peppers and cut onion into wedges; arrange with unpeeled garlic on a tray.
Toss with olive oil and roast at 210°C until softened and lightly charred.

stages.title: Blend the soup
steps: Squeeze roasted garlic from its skins and transfer vegetables to a blender with stock and paprika.
Blend in batches, venting the lid carefully for hot liquid, until smooth.

stages.title: Simmer and finish
steps: Pour blended soup into a saucepan and simmer gently over low heat for 10 minutes, until steaming hot, to meld flavours.
Season with salt and pepper, then stir in cream and torn basil just before serving.

batch_02.json::French Toast with Cinnamo.title: French toast with cinnamon
quick_steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, vanilla and cinnamon in a shallow dish until fully blended.
Heat a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat and melt a little butter.
Dip each brioche slice briefly in the custard on both sides, then let the excess drip off.
Cook the slices in batches, 2–3 minutes per side until golden and set in the centre. Add butter as needed and lower the heat if they brown too fast.
Stack on warm plates, scatter over the sliced strawberries, drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

stages.title: Make the custard
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla and cinnamon in a shallow dish until fully blended.
Set a large nonstick frying pan over medium heat and melt a little butter.

stages.title: Soak the bread
steps: Dip each brioche slice briefly into custard on both sides, allowing it to absorb without falling apart.
Let excess custard drip back into the dish before cooking.

stages.title: Cook in batches
steps: Lay slices in the pan without crowding and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and set in the centre.
Add more butter between batches as needed, lowering heat if the brioche browns too fast.

stages.title: Serve
steps: Stack slices on warm plates and scatter sliced strawberries over them.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

batch_02.json::Falafel Pita Pockets.title: Falafel pita pockets
quick_steps: Drain and dry the chickpeas, then pulse with the onion, garlic, cumin, coriander and parsley until coarse, not smooth.
Stir in the flour and season with salt, then chill for 10 minutes.
Shape into 12 firm patties, adding a little more flour if the mixture is wet.
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and cook the patties until golden on both sides and heated through.
Mix the yoghurt with finely diced cucumber and a pinch of salt. Warm the pita breads until warm through and slice open.
Stuff the pitas with falafel and cucumber yoghurt, adding lettuce or tomato if you like.

stages.title: Make the falafel mixture
steps: Drain and thoroughly dry chickpeas; pulse with onion, garlic, cumin, coriander and parsley until coarse, not smooth.
Stir in flour and season well; chill for 10 minutes to help the mixture hold together.

stages.title: Shape and cook
steps: Form 12 small patties, pressing firmly; add a little more flour if the mixture is wet.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan and cook patties over medium heat until golden on both sides and heated through.

stages.title: Prepare the sauce and fillings
steps: Mix yoghurt with finely diced cucumber and a pinch of salt.
Warm pita breads and slice pockets open carefully.

stages.title: Assemble
steps: Stuff pitas with falafel and cucumber yoghurt.
Add shredded lettuce or tomato if desired and serve immediately.

batch_02.json::Banana Oat Pancakes.title: Banana oat pancakes
quick_steps: Blend the bananas, eggs, oats, milk, baking powder, cinnamon and vanilla until mostly smooth.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly.
Warm a nonstick frying pan over medium-low heat and grease lightly with the butter. Test a teaspoon of batter to check it cooks gently without scorching.
Spoon small rounds into the pan, leaving room to flip. Cook 2–3 minutes until the edges look set, then flip and cook another 1–2 minutes.
Stack the pancakes and serve with yoghurt if you like. Loosen any leftover batter with a splash of milk if it thickens.

batch_02.json::Egg and Spinach Breakfast.title: Egg and spinach breakfast muffins
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and lightly oil a 12-hole muffin tin with the olive oil.
Finely dice the red pepper and spring onions, and chop the baby spinach.
Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper until just combined, then stir in the vegetables and grated cheddar.
Divide the mixture between the muffin holes, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 16–20 minutes until puffed and fully set in the centre.
Rest in the tin for 5 minutes, then loosen the edges and serve warm.

stages.title: Prepare vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and lightly oil a 12-hole muffin tin with the olive oil.
Finely dice red pepper and spring onions; chop spinach so it distributes evenly.

stages.title: Mix the eggs
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt and pepper until just combined.
Stir in vegetables and grated cheddar without overbeating.

stages.title: Bake the muffins
steps: Divide mixture between muffin holes, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake for 16–20 minutes until puffed and fully set in the centre.

stages.title: Cool and remove
steps: Let muffins stand in the tin for 5 minutes; they will settle slightly as they cool.
Loosen edges with a silicone spatula and serve warm.

batch_02.json::Crispy Tofu Rice Bowls.title: Crispy tofu rice bowls
quick_steps: Cook the jasmine rice over low heat until tender, following the packet directions, and keep it covered.
Wrap the tofu in a clean towel and press under a plate for 10 minutes.
Cut the tofu into cubes, pat dry and toss with the cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Heat the neutral oil in a nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Fry the tofu until golden and crisp on several sides.
Whisk the soy sauce, maple syrup, rice vinegar and sesame oil. Slice the cucumber and julienne the carrots.
Divide the rice among bowls, add the vegetables and top with the tofu. Drizzle with the dressing just before eating.

stages.title: Cook rice and press tofu
steps: Cook rice according to packet instructions over low heat until tender and keep covered.
Wrap tofu in a clean towel and press under a plate for 10 minutes to remove excess moisture.

stages.title: Coat and crisp tofu
steps: Cut tofu into cubes, pat dry and toss lightly with cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium-high heat and fry tofu, turning carefully, until golden and crisp on several sides.

stages.title: Mix the dressing
steps: Whisk soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar and sesame oil together.
Slice cucumber and julienne carrots while tofu finishes cooking.

stages.title: Build the bowls
steps: Divide rice among bowls and add fresh vegetables.
Top with crisp tofu and drizzle dressing just before eating to preserve texture.

batch_02.json::Baked Oatmeal with Apple.title: Baked oatmeal with apple
quick_steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a medium baking dish with the butter. Dice the apples and roughly chop the walnuts.
Whisk the eggs, milk, maple syrup and vanilla in a large bowl. Stir in the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and apples.
Pour into the dish and scatter with walnuts. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until the centre is set and the top is lightly golden.
Rest for 5 minutes so it holds its shape, then serve warm with yoghurt (optional) or a splash of milk.

batch_02.json::Breakfast Hash with Potat.title: Breakfast hash with potatoes
quick_steps: Dice the potatoes into 1.5 cm cubes and simmer in salted water for about 8 minutes until just tender at the edges. Drain and let the steam escape for 2 minutes.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Spread the potatoes in one layer and cook undisturbed until golden, then season with the smoked paprika and garlic powder.
Add the diced onion and red pepper and cook until softened and lightly charred. Season with salt, keeping the potatoes crisp.
Make four spaces in the hash and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with the parsley and serve straight from the pan.

batch_02.json::Sesame Cucumber Salad.title: Sesame cucumber salad
quick_steps: Slice the cucumbers into thin rounds, or lightly crush and cut into chunks. Toss with the salt and rest for 10 minutes.
Drain the cucumbers and pat them dry.
Whisk the rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, honey and chilli flakes until combined. Taste and adjust the vinegar or sweetness.
Just before serving, coat the cucumbers with the dressing, scatter over the sesame seeds and serve chilled.

batch_02.json::Creamy Coleslaw.title: Creamy coleslaw
quick_steps: Core and finely shred the white and red cabbage, then grate the carrots and pat the vegetables dry of excess moisture.
Whisk the mayonnaise, Greek yoghurt, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard and sugar until smooth.
Season the dressing with salt and pepper, tasting until the tang and sweetness are balanced.
Toss the vegetables with the dressing until evenly coated.
Refrigerate for at least 15 minutes, then give it a final stir just before serving.

batch_02.json::Garlic Green Beans with A.title: Garlic green beans with almonds
quick_steps: Boil the trimmed green beans in salted water for 3–4 minutes until bright green and just tender. Cool in cold water, then dry well.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat, shaking often, until lightly golden. Tip onto a plate straight away.
Melt the butter with the olive oil in the pan over medium heat. Add the finely sliced garlic and cook for 20–30 seconds.
Toss in the beans until hot. Add the lemon juice, almonds and a little black pepper.

batch_02.json::Cornbread with Honey Butt.title: Cornbread with honey butter
quick_steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and grease a 20 cm square tin. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt in one bowl.
Beat the eggs, buttermilk, melted butter and 1 tbsp honey in another bowl.
Fold the wet mix into the dry until no dry flour remains. A few small lumps are fine.
Spread the batter in the tin and bake 20–25 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin for 10 minutes.
Beat the softened butter with the remaining honey and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Cut the cornbread into squares and serve warm with a little honey butter on each.

batch_02.json::Roasted Cauliflower with.title: Roasted cauliflower with tahini
quick_steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cut the cauliflower into evenly sized florets, dry well and toss with the olive oil, cumin, paprika and salt.
Spread the florets on a baking tray, cut sides down where possible. Roast for 25–30 minutes, turning once, until tender and browned at the edges.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, grated garlic and a pinch of salt. Add the cold water gradually until smooth and pourable.
Transfer the hot cauliflower to a platter and drizzle with the tahini dressing. Finish with the parsley and extra lemon wedges.

batch_02.json::Crispy Smashed Potatoes.title: Crispy smashed potatoes
quick_steps: Cover the baby potatoes with cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer until a knife slides in easily.
Drain and let them steam dry for 5 minutes.
Space the potatoes out on an oiled baking tray and flatten each gently with the base of a glass.
Brush with olive oil and sprinkle over the rosemary, minced garlic and flaky salt.
Roast at 220°C for 20–25 minutes until deep golden and crisp, adding the parmesan for the last 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Rest for 2 minutes to firm the crisp edges, then serve with yoghurt if you like.

batch_02.json::Garlic Butter Mushrooms.title: Garlic butter mushrooms
quick_steps: Brush the mushrooms clean (or rinse quickly and dry well) and halve any large ones so the pieces are a similar size.
Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in a single layer and leave for 2–3 minutes.
Turn the mushrooms and cook until the moisture has evaporated and they are browned.
Lower the heat to medium-low. Add the butter and minced garlic and toss for 30–60 seconds until fragrant.
Finish with the lemon juice, parsley, salt and black pepper, then serve.

batch_02.json::Honey Roasted Carrots.title: Honey roasted carrots
quick_steps: Preheat the oven to 210°C and line a baking tray. Peel the carrots if needed and halve any thick ones lengthwise so they cook evenly.
Toss the carrots with the olive oil, thyme and salt, then spread in a single layer on the tray.
Roast for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until the edges start to caramelise.
Drizzle over the honey, toss to coat, then roast 5 more minutes until glossy and golden, watching so they don't burn. Finish with the lemon juice.

batch_02.json::Classic Tiramisu.title: Tiramisu
quick_steps: Whip the cold cream with the sugar and vanilla to soft peaks, then gently fold in the mascarpone until smooth and thick.
Pour the cooled coffee into a shallow bowl and briefly dip each savoiardi biscuit on both sides, so they stay firm and don't go soggy.
Arrange a single layer of dipped biscuits in a dish and spread over half the mascarpone cream.
Repeat with the remaining biscuits and cream, then smooth the top.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight, until set.
Dust generously with the cocoa powder just before serving.

batch_03.json::Vietnamese Lemongrass Chi.title: Vietnamese lemongrass chicken
quick_steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, brown sugar and lime juice in a bowl. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear. Simmer with water per the packet, then rest covered for 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in one layer for 5–6 minutes per side, until browned and 75°C in the thickest part.
Rest the chicken for 3 minutes, then slice across the grain.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the cucumber and pan juices.

batch_03.json::Persian Herb Frittata (Ku.title: Kuku sabzi (herb frittata)
quick_steps: Wash and thoroughly dry the parsley, coriander and dill, then chop finely. Combine with the spring onions, walnuts, turmeric, flour and salt.
Beat the eggs in a large bowl, then fold in the herb mixture until every leaf is coated.
Heat the olive oil in a non-stick, oven-safe frying pan over medium-low heat. Add the mixture, flatten gently and cook covered until the edges are set.
Transfer the pan to a 180°C oven until the centre is set and lightly browned.
Rest for 5 minutes, then cut into wedges.

batch_02.json::Vanilla Panna Cotta.title: Vanilla panna cotta
quick_steps: Soak the gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes until soft.
Split the vanilla bean and scrape the seeds into a saucepan with the cream, milk and sugar. Warm over low heat until the sugar dissolves, without boiling.
Off the heat, squeeze the water from the gelatine and whisk it in until fully dissolved.
Strain through a fine sieve into six ramekins, cool slightly, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until softly set.
Dip the bases briefly in warm water and turn out onto plates, or serve in the ramekins. Top with the berries just before serving.

batch_03.json::Mexican Pozole Verde.title: Pozole verde
quick_steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock with half the onion over medium heat for about 20 minutes, until cooked through to 75°C. Shred it and keep the broth.
Grill the tomatillos, jalapeño and remaining onion on high until blistered, then blend with the garlic, coriander stems and a ladle of broth.
Simmer the green sauce in a large pot over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add the broth, hominy, oregano and shredded chicken and simmer for 10 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and lime juice. Serve topped with the cabbage, coriander leaves and extra lime.

stages.title: Poach chicken
steps: Simmer chicken in stock with half the onion until cooked through to 75°C.
Remove chicken, cool slightly and shred; reserve the broth.

stages.title: Roast green vegetables
steps: Grill tomatillos, jalapeño and remaining onion until blistered.
Blend with garlic, coriander stems and a ladle of broth.

stages.title: Build soup
steps: Pour green sauce into a large pot and simmer 5 minutes.
Add broth, hominy, oregano and shredded chicken; simmer for 10 minutes until heated through.

stages.title: Finish bowls
steps: Season with salt and lime juice just before serving.
Top with cabbage, coriander leaves and extra lime.

batch_03.json::French Ratatouille.title: Ratatouille
quick_steps: Sprinkle the aubergine with salt, leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat most of the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Brown the aubergine, courgettes and capsicums in batches until lightly golden, then set aside.
Lower to medium heat. Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for about 5 minutes, without browning.
Add the tomatoes and thyme and simmer until juicy and starting to break down.
Return the vegetables to the pan and simmer gently until tender but not mushy.
Stir in the vinegar, season with salt and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

stages.title: Salt aubergine
steps: Sprinkle diced aubergine with a little salt and leave briefly.
Pat dry to remove surface moisture.

stages.title: Brown vegetables
steps: Cook aubergine in batches with oil over medium-high heat until lightly golden; transfer to a bowl.
Repeat with courgettes and capsicums so they retain some texture.

stages.title: Build tomato base
steps: Soften onion and garlic in remaining oil for about 5 minutes without browning.
Add tomatoes and thyme; simmer until juicy and beginning to break down.

stages.title: Finish stew
steps: Return vegetables to the pan and simmer gently until tender but not mushy.
Add vinegar, season and let stand 5 minutes before serving.

batch_03.json::Indian Palak Paneer.title: Palak paneer
quick_steps: Wilt the spinach in boiling water, then cool in cold water. Drain well and blend with a splash of water until smooth.
Heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat. Sizzle the cumin seeds for 20 seconds, then cook the onion until golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, chilli, tomatoes and turmeric. Cook until thick.
Stir in the spinach purée and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Add the garam masala and cream, loosening with a little water if needed.
Add the paneer and heat gently for 3–4 minutes until warmed through. Season, and serve with roti or rice if using.

stages.title: Blanch spinach
steps: Wilt spinach briefly in boiling water, then transfer to cold water.
Drain thoroughly and blend with a splash of water until smooth.

stages.title: Make masala
steps: Heat ghee and sizzle cumin seeds for 20 seconds.
Cook onion over medium heat until golden, then add ginger, garlic, chilli, tomatoes and turmeric until thick.

stages.title: Combine sauce
steps: Stir spinach purée into masala and simmer gently for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add garam masala and cream, loosening with water if needed.

stages.title: Warm paneer
steps: Add paneer cubes and heat gently until warmed through.
Season and serve with roti or rice; avoid boiling hard or paneer may toughen.

batch_03.json::Japanese Chicken Katsu Cu.title: Chicken katsu curry
quick_steps: Cook the onion and carrot in a saucepan with a little oil over medium heat until softened. Add the potato and water, then simmer until tender.
Turn off the heat and dissolve the curry roux a little at a time. Return to a gentle simmer until glossy and thick.
Flatten the chicken breasts to 1.5 cm, season, then coat in flour, egg and panko, pressing the crumbs on firmly.
Shallow-fry the chicken in hot oil over medium heat until golden on both sides and 75°C in the centre.
Rest briefly, slice and serve with the rice and curry.

stages.title: Start curry base
steps: Cook onion and carrot in a saucepan with a little oil over medium heat until softened.
Add potato and water; simmer until the vegetables are tender.

stages.title: Finish curry
steps: Turn off the heat and dissolve curry roux blocks a little at a time.
Return to a gentle simmer, stirring until glossy and thick.

stages.title: Crumb chicken
steps: Flatten breasts to even 1.5 cm thickness and season.
Coat in flour, beaten egg and panko, pressing crumbs firmly into the meat.

stages.title: Cook cutlets
steps: Shallow-fry in hot oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.
Check the centre reaches 75°C, rest briefly and slice; serve with rice and curry.

batch_03.json::Ethiopian Misir Wot.title: Misir wot
quick_steps: Cook the onions in a dry heavy pot over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes until softened and golden. Add the olive oil once they catch and cook until sweet and reduced.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, berbere and tomato paste. Cook over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant, adding a splash of water if it scorches.
Add the lentils and water. Simmer gently for about 25 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils break down into a thick stew.
Loosen with a little hot water if the stew gets too stiff. Season with the salt.
Serve with rice or injera.

batch_03.json::Korean Kimchi Fried Rice.title: Kimchi fried rice
quick_steps: Break up the chilled rice and chop the kimchi. Mix the gochujang, kimchi juice and soy sauce into a sauce.
Heat the neutral oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the kimchi for about 4 minutes, until the edges caramelise and the pan looks less wet.
Add the rice and sauce, tossing to coat. Press the rice against the pan for a few minutes, until crisp in spots.
Stir through the sesame oil and sliced spring onions until heated through.
Fry the eggs separately until the whites are fully set and the yolks are done how you like them. Top the rice with the eggs and sesame seeds.

batch_03.json::Moroccan Harira Soup.title: Harira
quick_steps: Soften the onion and celery in the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat for about 5 minutes until soft. Stir in the ginger, turmeric and cinnamon for 30 seconds.
Add the grated tomatoes, lentils and stock. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for about 30 minutes until the lentils are tender, then add the chickpeas.
Break the vermicelli into short lengths and stir in. Simmer for about 7 minutes until just cooked, adding water if the soup gets too thick.
Stir through the chopped coriander and the juice of the lemon. Season to taste and serve with extra lemon wedges.

stages.title: Cook aromatic base
steps: Soften onion and celery in olive oil over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger, turmeric and cinnamon, stirring for 30 seconds.

stages.title: Simmer legumes
steps: Add grated tomatoes, lentils and stock and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook until lentils are tender, then add drained chickpeas.

stages.title: Add noodles
steps: Break vermicelli into short lengths and stir into soup.
Simmer until the vermicelli is just cooked, adding water if soup thickens too much.

stages.title: Finish fresh
steps: Stir through chopped coriander and lemon juice.
Taste and season, then serve with extra lemon wedges.

batch_03.json::American Turkey Chilli.title: Turkey chilli
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and capsicum for about 5 minutes until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the turkey mince, breaking it up, and cook until no pink remains and most of the liquid has evaporated, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and spices (cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder) and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer uncovered for about 25 minutes until thick and rich.
Season with salt and adjust the chilli heat, then rest for 5 minutes. Serve with rice or yoghurt if you like.

stages.title: Soften vegetables
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook onion and capsicum for about 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.

stages.title: Brown turkey
steps: Add turkey mince and break it into small pieces.
Cook until no pink remains and excess liquid has mostly evaporated.

stages.title: Build chilli
steps: Stir in tomato paste and spices, cooking 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, beans and stock; simmer uncovered until thick and rich.

stages.title: Finish
steps: Taste and adjust salt and chilli heat.
Rest 5 minutes before serving with rice or yoghurt.

batch_03.json::Portuguese Piri Piri Chic.title: Piri piri chicken
quick_steps: Blend the chillies, garlic, lemon juice, vinegar, paprika, oregano, oil and salt into a marinade. Taste and adjust the heat.
Pat the chicken dry and score the thick parts. Coat in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes if time allows.
Arrange the chicken skin-side up on a rack over a tray. Roast at 200°C for about 35 minutes, turning the tray halfway, until the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Rest the chicken for 5–10 minutes so the juices settle.
Serve with lemon wedges and roasted potatoes, if using.

batch_03.json::Cajun Shrimp and Grits.title: Cajun shrimp and grits
quick_steps: Simmer the stock and milk over medium heat, whisk in the grits and cook until thick and creamy, about 10 minutes. Stir in the cheddar.
Pat the prawns dry and toss with the Cajun seasoning. Chop the capsicum, garlic and spring onions.
Heat the butter and oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Cook the capsicum for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic and prawns and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until pink, opaque and firm.
Loosen the grits with a little warm water if needed and spoon into bowls. Top with the prawns, pan juices and sliced spring onions.

stages.title: Cook grits
steps: Bring stock and milk to a simmer and whisk in grits gradually.
Cook according to packet, stirring frequently until creamy; stir in cheddar.

stages.title: Prepare prawns
steps: Pat prawns dry and toss with Cajun seasoning.
Chop capsicum, garlic and spring onions while grits cook.

stages.title: Sauté topping
steps: Heat butter and oil in a pan over medium-high heat and soften capsicum for 3 minutes.
Add garlic and prawns; cook for 2 to 3 minutes until prawns turn pink, opaque and firm.

stages.title: Serve immediately
steps: Loosen grits with warm water if needed and spoon into bowls.
Top with prawns, pan juices and sliced spring onions.

batch_03.json::Spanish Seafood Paella.title: Seafood paella
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan over medium heat and soften the capsicum for about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, grated tomatoes and smoked paprika. Cook for about 7 minutes, until reduced to a thick paste.
Stir in the bomba rice to coat it, then add the hot fish stock with the saffron and spread the rice evenly.
Simmer without stirring for 8–10 minutes, adjusting the heat to keep a gentle bubble. Arrange the prawns and mussels on top.
Cook for another 8–10 minutes, until the prawns are opaque and the mussels have opened. Discard any that stay closed, rest covered for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

stages.title: Prepare sofrito
steps: Heat oil in a wide paella pan over medium heat and soften capsicum for about 5 minutes, until soft.
Add garlic, grated tomato and paprika; cook until reduced to a thick paste.

stages.title: Toast rice
steps: Stir in rice so each grain is coated in the sofrito.
Add saffron-infused hot stock and distribute rice evenly across the pan.

stages.title: Cook undisturbed
steps: Simmer without stirring for 8–10 minutes, adjusting heat to maintain a gentle bubbling surface.
Arrange prawns and mussels on top and cook for the final 8–10 minutes, until prawns are opaque and mussels have opened.

stages.title: Rest and serve
steps: Check prawns are opaque and mussels have opened; discard any that remain closed.
Rest paella covered loosely for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

batch_03.json::Italian Arancini.title: Arancini
quick_steps: Chill the cooked risotto rice until firm. Cube the mozzarella and simmer the passata until thick, so the filling won't leak.
With damp hands, flatten a portion of rice, add a mozzarella cube and a teaspoon of passata, then seal into a ball.
Roll each ball in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs. Press crumbs over any cracks and chill briefly if soft.
Heat the oil to 170–175°C and fry in batches until golden and piping hot inside.
Drain on a rack and sprinkle with the Parmesan before serving.

batch_03.json::Italian Gnocchi alla Sorr.title: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
quick_steps: Warm the oil and garlic in a saucepan over low heat for about 1 minute until fragrant, without browning.
Add the passata and salt and simmer over medium heat for about 10 minutes until slightly thickened, then stir through the torn basil.
Boil the gnocchi in batches in gently boiling salted water, lifting each batch out with a slotted spoon as soon as it floats, about 2 minutes.
Toss the gnocchi with the sauce in an ovenproof dish, then dot with the mozzarella and sprinkle over the Parmesan.
Bake at 220°C for about 10 minutes until the cheese bubbles and lightly browns, then rest for 3 minutes before serving.

batch_03.json::Brazilian Black Bean Stew.title: Brazilian black bean stew
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Brown the sausage for 3 to 4 minutes, until browned on both sides, then remove it.
Cook the onion in the pot over medium heat until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic, cumin and bay leaves and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans, stock and sausage and bring to a gentle simmer for about 35 minutes. Mash a spoonful of beans against the pot to thicken the stew.
Simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes, until thick but still spoonable.
Remove the bay leaves. Serve with the rice and orange wedges.

stages.title: Brown sausage
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown sliced sausage on both sides, about 3 to 4 minutes, until deeply browned.
Remove sausage, leaving a little flavoured oil in the pot.

stages.title: Build aromatics
steps: Cook onion until soft and lightly golden.
Add garlic, cumin and bay leaves and stir for 1 minute.

stages.title: Simmer beans
steps: Add beans, stock and sausage; bring to a gentle simmer.
Mash a spoonful of beans against the pot to thicken the liquid naturally.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Simmer uncovered until stew is thick but still spoonable.
Remove bay leaves and serve with rice and orange wedges.

batch_03.json::Brazilian Black Bean Stew.hand_fixed: drift judge flag, fixed by hand (approved 2026-11-20)

batch_03.json::Japanese Miso Aubergine (.title: Miso aubergine (nasu dengaku)
quick_steps: Halve the aubergines lengthways, score the flesh in a shallow crosshatch without cutting the skin, then brush the cut sides with oil and place on a baking tray.
Roast cut-side up at 210°C for about 20 minutes, until the flesh is golden and a spoon presses in with no resistance.
Whisk the miso, mirin, sugar and sake (or water) until smooth. Warm in a small pan over low heat until the sugar dissolves.
Spread the glaze over the aubergine and grill for about 4 minutes, until bubbling and caramelised.
Scatter the sesame seeds and sliced spring onions over the top.

batch_03.json::Indian Aloo Gobi.title: Aloo gobi
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat and sizzle the cumin seeds for 20 seconds. Add the potatoes and cook until the edges start to colour.
Add the onion, ginger and garlic and cook until softened. Stir in the turmeric and ground coriander briefly.
Add the cauliflower, tomatoes and a splash of water. Cover and cook over medium-low heat until the potatoes and cauliflower are tender, about 15 minutes.
Remove the lid and cook for about 5 minutes, until the moisture has cooked off and the spices cling to the vegetables. Season and finish with the coriander leaves.

stages.title: Start potatoes
steps: Heat oil in a wide pan over medium heat and sizzle cumin seeds for 20 seconds.
Add potatoes and cook over medium heat until edges begin to colour.

stages.title: Add aromatics
steps: Stir in onion, ginger and garlic and cook until softened.
Add turmeric and ground coriander, stirring briefly.

stages.title: Cook cauliflower
steps: Add cauliflower, tomatoes and a splash of water.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat, stirring gently, until potatoes and cauliflower are tender.

stages.title: Dry and finish
steps: Remove lid and cook off excess moisture for about 5 minutes, until the spices cling to vegetables.
Season and finish with fresh coriander.

batch_03.json::Vietnamese Banh Mi Sandwi.title: Bánh mì
quick_steps: Toss the carrot and daikon with the rice vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt. Leave to soften for about 10 minutes, then drain lightly.
Mix the soy sauce, fish sauce and garlic, then coat the pork slices. Leave to stand briefly while the pan heats.
Sear the pork in batches in an oiled frying pan over high heat until browned and cooked through to 63°C. Rest for 3 minutes.
Reduce any remaining clean marinade separately until slightly thickened, then spoon it over the pork.
Warm the baguettes until crusty, then split and spread with the mayonnaise. Layer the cucumber, pork, pickles and coriander, and serve immediately.

batch_03.json::Mediterranean Stuffed Pep.title: Mediterranean stuffed peppers
quick_steps: Halve the capsicums lengthways, keeping the stems, and remove the seeds. Brush with olive oil and place cut-side up in a baking dish.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat and soften the onion in oil for about 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes and oregano.
Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the tomatoes lose their excess moisture, then fold in the rice, olives and lemon zest. Let cool.
Stir the parsley and half the feta through the filling, then pack into the capsicums and top with the remaining feta.
Add a splash of water to the dish and cover loosely with foil. Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake for about 15 minutes more, until the capsicums are tender and the tops are lightly golden.

stages.title: Prepare peppers
steps: Halve capsicums lengthways and remove seeds while keeping stems intact.
Brush with oil and place cut-side up in a baking dish.

stages.title: Cook filling
steps: Soften onion in a frying pan with oil over medium heat for about 5 minutes until translucent, then add tomatoes and oregano.
Cook until tomatoes lose excess moisture and fold in rice, olives and lemon zest.

stages.title: Fill peppers
steps: Stir parsley and half the feta through the cooled filling.
Pack mixture into pepper halves and sprinkle with remaining feta.

stages.title: Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Add a splash of water to the dish and cover loosely with foil for 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake until peppers are tender and tops lightly golden.

batch_03.json::Thai Basil Chicken (Pad K.title: Thai basil chicken (pad krapow)
quick_steps: Rinse the jasmine rice and cook on low heat per the packet until tender. Keep covered and warm.
Stir the oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar together. Finely chop the garlic and chillies.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Fry the garlic and chilli briefly until fragrant.
Add the chicken mince, breaking it up, and cook until cooked through (75°C), about 6 minutes.
Add the sauce and toss until it coats the meat and reduces slightly.
Turn off the heat, fold in the basil and serve over the rice.

stages.title: Cook rice
steps: Rinse rice and cook according to packet instructions, on low heat once boiling, until tender.
Keep covered and warm while preparing the stir-fry.

stages.title: Mix sauce
steps: Stir oyster sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce and sugar together.
Chop garlic and chilli finely so they release flavour quickly.

stages.title: Stir-fry chicken
steps: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and briefly fry garlic and chilli.
Add chicken mince, breaking it up and cooking until fully cooked through to 75°C.

stages.title: Finish with basil
steps: Add sauce and toss until it coats the meat and reduces slightly.
Turn off heat, fold in basil and serve over rice.

batch_03.json::Turkish Menemen.title: Menemen
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and green peppers for about 6 minutes, until tender.
Add the grated tomatoes, paprika and salt. Simmer uncovered for about 7 minutes, until the liquid evaporates and the sauce thickens.
Lightly beat the eggs and pour them in. Cook over low heat for about 4 minutes, until softly set and still moist.
Take the pan off the heat before the eggs dry out. Scatter over the parsley and serve with the crusty bread for scooping.

stages.title: Soften peppers
steps: Heat olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and cook onion and peppers until tender.
Avoid high heat so the vegetables sweeten rather than scorch.

stages.title: Reduce tomatoes
steps: Add grated tomatoes, paprika and salt.
Simmer uncovered until excess liquid evaporates and sauce thickens.

stages.title: Add eggs
steps: Beat eggs lightly and pour into tomato mixture.
Stir slowly over low heat until softly set and still moist.

stages.title: Serve hot
steps: Remove pan from heat before eggs become dry.
Sprinkle parsley over and serve with bread for scooping.

batch_03.json::Scottish Porridge with St.title: Porridge with stewed pears
quick_steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium-low heat. Cook the pears and cinnamon until soft but holding their shape, then stir in the honey.
Combine the oats, milk, water and salt in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often.
Reduce to low and simmer until the oats are tender and the porridge thickens. Add a splash more milk if it gets too stiff.
Divide the porridge into bowls, spoon the warm pears over and scatter with the walnuts.

batch_03.json::Italian Minestrone.title: Minestrone
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-low heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery for about 10 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, stock and courgette and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook for about 20 minutes, until the vegetables are nearly tender.
Stir in the cannellini beans and pasta. Simmer for about 10 minutes until the pasta is al dente, adding water if the soup gets too thick.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with grated Parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

stages.title: Sweat vegetables
steps: Heat oil and cook onion, carrot and celery over medium-low heat until softened.
Add garlic and oregano and cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.

stages.title: Build soup
steps: Add tomatoes, stock and courgette, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook until vegetables are nearly tender.

stages.title: Cook pasta
steps: Stir in drained beans and pasta.
Simmer until pasta is al dente, adding water if the soup thickens too much.

stages.title: Finish bowls
steps: Taste and season with salt and pepper.
Serve with grated Parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

batch_03.json::American Cobb Salad.title: Cobb salad
quick_steps: Cook the chicken in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat until the centre reaches 75°C, then rest and dice.
Cook the bacon until crisp. Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool and quarter.
Chop the cos lettuce, and dice the tomatoes and avocado just before assembling.
Whisk the vinegar, Dijon mustard and olive oil until emulsified, then season lightly with salt.
Spread the lettuce on a platter and arrange the chicken, bacon, eggs, tomatoes and avocado in rows. Crumble over the blue cheese and drizzle with dressing at serving.

batch_03.json::Australian Smashed Avocad.title: Smashed avocado toast
quick_steps: Toast the sourdough until crisp and golden on the outside, then place on plates while still warm.
Mash the avocado roughly with the lemon juice and salt, keeping some chunks for texture.
Spread the avocado over the toast, then scatter over the feta, chilli flakes and mint.
Drizzle with the olive oil and serve straight away.

batch_03.json::Mexican Huevos Rancheros.title: Huevos rancheros
quick_steps: Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeño in a little oil in a pan over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until soft. Add the tomatoes and cumin and simmer until thick enough to spoon.
Warm the beans with a splash of water and a pinch of salt over medium heat until hot. Mash a small portion for a creamy texture.
Fry the eggs in oil in a non-stick pan until the whites are fully set. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until pliable.
Spread the beans on the tortillas and add a spoonful of salsa. Top with the eggs, sliced avocado and a squeeze of lime juice.

stages.title: Cook salsa
steps: Soften onion, garlic and jalapeño in a little oil over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until soft.
Add tomatoes and cumin and simmer until thick enough to spoon.

stages.title: Warm beans
steps: Heat drained beans with a splash of water and pinch of salt.
Mash a small portion to create a creamy texture.

stages.title: Cook eggs
steps: Heat oil in a non-stick pan and fry eggs until whites are fully set.
Warm tortillas separately in a dry pan until pliable.

stages.title: Assemble plates
steps: Spread beans on tortillas and add a spoonful of salsa.
Top with eggs, avocado slices and lime juice.

batch_03.json::Peruvian Lomo Saltado.title: Lomo saltado
quick_steps: Bake the oven chips at 220°C according to the packet, until crisp. Slice the sirloin across the grain and pat dry.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat until very hot. Sear the steak in batches, about 1 minute per side, until browned. Remove.
Stir-fry the red onion wedges in the wok until charred at the edges but still crisp. Add the garlic and tomato wedges and toss for 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the soy sauce, red wine vinegar and cumin. Toss for about 1 minute, until coated and cooked to your liking.
Serve straight away with the chips, rice and coriander.

stages.title: Prepare components
steps: Bake oven chips at 220°C according to packet instructions until crisp.
Slice steak across the grain and pat dry for good browning.

stages.title: Sear beef
steps: Heat a wok or large pan over high heat until very hot, then add oil.
Sear steak quickly in batches, about 1 minute per side until browned, so it browns rather than steams; remove.

stages.title: Stir-fry vegetables
steps: Add onion wedges and cook until charred at edges but still crisp.
Add garlic and tomato wedges and toss briefly for 30 seconds.

stages.title: Combine and serve
steps: Return beef with soy sauce, vinegar and cumin, tossing for about 1 minute until coated and cooked to preference.
Serve immediately with chips, rice and coriander.

batch_03.json::French Croque Monsieur.title: Croque monsieur
quick_steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute without browning.
Whisk in the milk gradually and simmer until smooth and thick, then season with the nutmeg.
Spread the sourdough with Dijon mustard, then layer on the ham and half the Gruyère. Close into sandwiches and place on a lined baking tray.
Spoon the béchamel over each sandwich and scatter on the remaining Gruyère.
Bake at 220°C until the bread is crisp and the topping bubbles and browns.
Rest for 2 minutes before cutting, then serve hot with a sharp green salad.

stages.title: Make béchamel
steps: Melt butter over medium heat, stir in flour and cook 1 minute without browning.
Whisk in milk gradually and simmer until smooth and thick; season with nutmeg.

stages.title: Build sandwiches
steps: Spread bread with mustard and layer ham and half the cheese.
Close sandwiches and place on a lined baking tray.

stages.title: Top and bake
steps: Spoon béchamel over each sandwich and scatter remaining cheese on top.
Bake at 220°C until bread is crisp and topping bubbles and browns.

stages.title: Rest briefly
steps: Let sandwiches stand for 2 minutes before cutting.
Serve hot with a sharp green salad.

batch_03.json::Chinese Congee with Ginge.title: Congee with ginger
quick_steps: Rinse the jasmine rice and drain. Put it in a heavy saucepan with the stock and sliced ginger.
Bring to the boil over high heat, then reduce to low for a very gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered for about 50 minutes, until the rice starts to break down, stirring now and then so it doesn't stick.
Keep cooking for about 10 minutes, until the congee is thick and silky. Loosen with hot water if needed, then season with the soy sauce and white pepper.
Remove the large ginger slices and ladle the congee into bowls.
Top with sliced eggs, spring onions and a few drops of sesame oil.

stages.title: Rinse rice
steps: Rinse rice briefly and drain.
Place in a heavy saucepan with stock and sliced ginger.
