stages.title: Simmer gently
steps: Bring to a boil, then lower to a very gentle simmer.
Cook uncovered over low heat for about 50 minutes, until the rice begins to break down, stirring occasionally so rice does not stick to the base.

stages.title: Adjust texture
steps: Continue cooking until grains break down and porridge is thick and silky.
Add hot water to loosen if needed, then season with soy sauce and white pepper.

stages.title: Finish bowls
steps: Remove large ginger slices and ladle congee into bowls.
Top with sliced eggs, spring onions and a few drops of sesame oil.

batch_03.json::American Blueberry Muffin.title: Blueberry muffins
quick_steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a 12-hole muffin tray. Toss the blueberries with the extra tablespoon of flour.
Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in one bowl. In another, whisk the eggs, milk, cooled melted butter and vanilla.
Fold the wet mixture into the dry until no dry flour remains, then gently fold in the blueberries. A few lumps are fine.
Divide the batter among the cases and bake until risen and a skewer comes out without wet batter.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

batch_03.json::Indian Poha with Peanuts.title: Poha with peanuts
quick_steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve until just damp, then leave it to soften so the grains stay separate.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Pop the mustard seeds, then add the curry leaves carefully.
Add the potato and cook covered for about 8 minutes, until tender.
Add the onion and green chilli and cook until soft. Stir in the turmeric and peanuts for 30 seconds.
Fold the poha through gently and warm until steaming. Season with salt, lemon juice and coriander.

stages.title: Rinse poha
steps: Rinse poha briefly in a sieve until just damp, then leave to soften.
Check grains remain separate and are not waterlogged.

stages.title: Cook potato
steps: Heat oil over medium heat, pop mustard seeds and add curry leaves carefully.
Add diced potato and cook covered over medium heat until tender, stirring occasionally.

stages.title: Add aromatics
steps: Add onion and chilli and cook until soft.
Stir in turmeric and peanuts for 30 seconds.

stages.title: Finish poha
steps: Fold softened poha through gently and warm until steaming.
Season with salt, lemon juice and coriander.

batch_03.json::Italian Affogato.title: Affogato
quick_steps: Chill two serving glasses in the freezer for about 2 minutes, then scoop the vanilla gelato into them.
Brew two fresh espresso shots just before serving, so the coffee is piping hot.
Pour one hot espresso shot over the gelato in each glass.
Top with the grated dark chocolate and crushed amaretti biscuits, then serve straight away with spoons before the gelato melts completely.

batch_03.json::New York Baked Cheesecake.title: New York baked cheesecake
quick_steps: Crush the digestive biscuits and mix with the melted butter. Press into a lined springform tin and chill while you make the filling.
Beat the cream cheese and caster sugar until smooth. Mix in the eggs one at a time, then the sour cream, vanilla, lemon zest and cornflour, without overbeating.
Pour the filling over the crust and bake at 160°C until the edges are set but the centre still wobbles slightly.
Turn off the oven and leave the door ajar for 30 minutes to cool gradually.
Cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
Run a warm knife around the edge, then remove the tin and slice.

batch_03.json::Japanese Matcha Shortbrea.title: Matcha shortbread
quick_steps: Beat the softened butter and icing sugar until smooth and pale, then mix in the egg yolk.
Sift the flour, matcha and salt together, then fold into the butter mixture until a soft dough forms.
Roll the dough into a 4 cm wide log, wrap tightly and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, until firm enough to slice.
Cut the log into 7 mm rounds and arrange on lined trays.
Bake at 165°C until the edges are set but the biscuits are still green, then cool on the tray.

batch_03.json::French Chocolate Mousse.title: French chocolate mousse
quick_steps: Melt the chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water on low heat. Take it off the heat and cool until just warm.
Whip the cold cream to soft peaks, not stiff, then refrigerate.
Beat the egg whites with the salt until foamy, then add the sugar gradually. Keep beating until glossy medium peaks form.
Stir the egg yolks and vanilla into the cooled chocolate, then fold in the cream and egg whites in batches.
Divide into glasses and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, until set.

stages.title: Melt chocolate
steps: Melt chocolate gently over a pan of barely simmering water.
Remove from heat and cool until just warm, not hot.

stages.title: Whip cream
steps: Whip cold cream to soft peaks and refrigerate briefly.
Avoid stiff peaks, which make folding difficult.

stages.title: Whip egg whites
steps: Beat pasteurised egg whites with salt until foamy, then add sugar gradually.
Continue until glossy medium peaks form.

stages.title: Fold and chill
steps: Stir egg yolks and vanilla into cooled chocolate, then fold in cream and egg whites in batches.
Divide into glasses and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

batch_03.json::Indian Mango Lassi.title: Mango lassi
quick_steps: Peel the mango and cut the flesh from the stone. Chill it first if you like a colder drink.
Blend the mango, yoghurt, milk, honey and cardamom until completely smooth and creamy.
Taste for sweetness, adding a splash more milk if it's too thick. Blend briefly with the ice cubes until frosty.
Pour into two glasses and serve immediately, dusted lightly with a little extra cardamom if you like.

batch_03.json::Chinese Scallion Pancakes.title: Scallion pancakes
quick_steps: Mix the flour and salt, stir in the hot water until shaggy, then knead until smooth. Cover and rest for 20 minutes.
Divide the dough into four balls and roll each into a thin circle. Brush with sesame oil and scatter over the spring onions.
Roll each circle into a tight log, coil it like a snail and tuck the end underneath. Rest briefly, then roll flat into rounds.
Fry in the neutral oil in a pan over medium heat until golden and crisp on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with the soy sauce mixed with the rice vinegar.

batch_03.json::British Sticky Toffee Pud.title: Sticky toffee pudding
quick_steps: Pour the boiling water over the dates and stir in the bicarbonate of soda. Leave until soft, then mash to a coarse paste.
Beat the butter and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, vanilla and date mixture just until combined.
Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 180°C until risen and a skewer comes out clean. Rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the cream, the sauce brown sugar and the sauce butter in a pan over low heat until dissolved. Simmer for 3–4 minutes until glossy.
Pour the toffee sauce over the warm pudding.

batch_04.json::Chicken Adobo.title: Chicken adobo
quick_steps: Combine the soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaves and peppercorns in a bowl. Turn the chicken through and refrigerate for 20 minutes, reserving the liquid.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Brown the chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes, then turn and cook 3–5 minutes more.
Pour in the reserved marinade and water and bring to a full boil, then lower the heat. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Uncover and reduce for 10 minutes, until the sauce is glossy and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Taste the sauce, adding a splash of water if too salty or a little vinegar if too rich. Serve the chicken and sauce over steamed rice.

batch_04.json::Classic French Quiche Lor.title: Quiche Lorraine
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Press the pastry into a 23 cm tart tin, line with baking paper and weights, and bake 15 minutes. Remove the weights and bake 5 minutes more.
Fry the bacon in a dry pan over medium heat until lightly golden and the fat has rendered. Drain on kitchen paper.
Whisk the eggs, cream, milk, nutmeg and pepper until just combined, without making it foamy.
Scatter the bacon and Gruyère over the baked pastry case, then pour in the custard.
Bake at 180°C for 30–35 minutes, until the edges are set and the centre just wobbles.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

batch_04.json::Beef Rendang.title: Beef rendang
quick_steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, chillies and ground coriander with a splash of water until coarse. Cut the beef into 4 cm cubes.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Fry the paste until fragrant and darker, then add the lemongrass and lime leaves until aromatic.
Add the beef, coconut milk and salt. Bring to a simmer, then lower the heat.
Cook uncovered or partly covered for 2 hours, stirring more often as the liquid reduces, until the beef is tender.
Keep cooking gently for about 25 minutes until the sauce thickens and clings to the meat. Stop when the paste is deep brown and the beef pulls apart easily.

batch_04.json::Japanese Teriyaki Chicken.title: Teriyaki chicken donburi
quick_steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear, then cook it over low heat with the packet amount of water. Rest covered for 10 minutes and fluff.
Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sake (or water) and brown sugar until the sugar dissolves. Thinly slice the spring onions.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken thighs 5–6 minutes each side, until the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer, turning the chicken, until glossy and lightly thickened.
Slice the chicken and spoon it over the rice with the pan glaze. Top with spring onions and sesame seeds.

stages.title: Cook the rice
steps: Rinse rice until the water runs nearly clear and cook over low heat with the packet-specified amount of water.
Rest covered for 10 minutes after cooking, then fluff with a fork.

stages.title: Mix the glaze
steps: Stir soy sauce, mirin, sake and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Slice spring onions thinly and keep the green tops for serving.

stages.title: Sear chicken
steps: Heat oil in a skillet and cook thighs over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes each side.
Check the thickest part reaches 75°C before removing excess rendered fat.

stages.title: Glaze and serve
steps: Pour sauce into the pan and simmer, turning chicken, until glossy and lightly thickened.
Slice chicken and spoon over rice with pan glaze, spring onions and sesame seeds.

batch_04.json::Chinese Char Siu Pork.title: Char siu pork
quick_steps: Whisk the hoisin, soy, honey, Shaoxing wine, five-spice, garlic and brown sugar into a glaze. Set 2 tablespoons aside in a clean bowl for basting.
Coat the pork strips in the remaining glaze and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Arrange the pork on a rack over a foil-lined tray and roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Brush with the reserved glaze and roast until the pork is cooked through and tender.
Increase the oven to 220°C for a few minutes until the edges are sticky and lightly charred. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice across the grain.

batch_04.json::Moroccan Chicken Tagine w.title: Moroccan chicken tagine with olives
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a casserole over medium-high heat. Brown the seasoned chicken thighs for 3–4 minutes per side until deep golden, then set aside.
Reduce to medium-low and cook the sliced onion until soft, scraping up the browned bits. Stir in the garlic, ginger, turmeric and cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Return the chicken to the pan with the stock, bring to a simmer and cover. Cook 30–35 minutes until tender and 75°C in the thickest part.
Rinse and finely slice the preserved lemon rind. Stir it in with the olives and simmer uncovered until the sauce lightly thickens, then finish with coriander.

stages.title: Brown chicken
steps: Heat olive oil in a casserole over medium-high heat and season chicken lightly.
Brown thighs on both sides for 3–4 minutes per side until deep golden, then transfer to a plate without cooking through.

stages.title: Soften aromatics
steps: Lower heat and cook onion until softened, scraping up browned bits.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric and cumin and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant.

stages.title: Braise gently
steps: Return chicken with stock, bring to a simmer and cover.
Cook 30–35 minutes until tender and the thickest part reaches 75°C.

stages.title: Add preserved lemon
steps: Rinse preserved lemon and finely slice the rind; discard excess pulp and seeds.
Stir in olives and lemon rind, simmer uncovered until sauce lightly thickens, then finish with coriander.

batch_04.json::Korean Beef Bulgogi.title: Beef bulgogi
quick_steps: Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, grated pear, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Toss through the sliced beef and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
Slice the onion into fine half-moons and cut the spring onions into 4 cm pieces. Drain the excess marinade from the beef so it sears.
Heat the neutral oil in a large frying pan over high heat until very hot.
Cook the beef in small batches for 2–3 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Return all the beef to the pan with the onion and spring onions. Toss until the onion softens slightly.
Serve straight away with rice and lettuce leaves, if using.

batch_04.json::Mexican Chicken Enchilada.title: Chicken enchiladas rojas
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and soften the diced onion until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Stir in the shredded chicken and 100 ml of the enchilada sauce until steaming hot.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat until pliable, then spread a thin layer of sauce over a baking dish.
Divide the chicken mixture between the tortillas, roll up and place seam-side down in the dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and scatter with the cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 18–22 minutes until bubbling and hot throughout. Rest 5 minutes, then top with sour cream and coriander.

stages.title: Prepare filling
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and soften diced onion until translucent.
Stir in shredded chicken and 100 ml enchilada sauce, heating until steaming hot.

stages.title: Soften tortillas
steps: Heat tortillas briefly in a dry skillet so they roll without cracking.
Spread a thin layer of sauce across the base of a baking dish.

stages.title: Fill and roll
steps: Divide chicken mixture between tortillas, roll tightly and arrange seam-side down.
Pour remaining sauce over the top and scatter with grated cheese.

stages.title: Bake and serve
steps: Bake at 190°C conventional for 18–22 minutes until bubbling and hot throughout.
Rest 5 minutes, then top with sour cream and coriander.

batch_04.json::Indian Butter Chicken.title: Butter chicken
quick_steps: Mix the yoghurt, half the garam masala, paprika, half the garlic and the salt. Coat the chicken and marinate in the fridge for at least 20 minutes.
Melt 20 g butter in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken in batches until lightly coloured, then set aside (it finishes in the sauce).
Add the remaining butter, garlic, ginger and tomato paste, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the passata and remaining garam masala. Simmer for 15 minutes, blending if you want a silky sauce.
Return the chicken and juices and simmer until it reaches 75°C. Reduce the heat, stir in the cream and season with salt.
Serve with rice, if using.

stages.title: Marinate chicken
steps: Mix yoghurt, half the garam masala, paprika, half the garlic and salt.
Coat chicken and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes before cooking.

stages.title: Sear the chicken
steps: Heat 20 g butter in a wide pan over medium-high heat and cook chicken in batches until lightly coloured.
Remove to a plate; the chicken will finish cooking in the sauce.

stages.title: Build the sauce
steps: Add remaining butter, garlic, ginger and tomato paste; stir for 1 minute.
Add passata and remaining garam masala, simmer 15 minutes and blend carefully if a silky sauce is preferred.

stages.title: Finish gently
steps: Return chicken and juices, simmer until chicken reaches 75°C.
Reduce heat, stir in cream and taste for salt before serving with rice.

batch_04.json::Spanish Chicken and Chori.title: Spanish chicken and chorizo rice
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Brown the seasoned chicken for about 5 minutes, then add the sliced chorizo and cook until it releases its red oil. Transfer both to a plate.
In the same pan over medium heat, soften the onion and capsicum for about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the tomatoes and rice until the grains are well coated.

Pour in the hot stock with the saffron and return the chicken and chorizo. Simmer gently over medium-low heat without stirring for 18 to 22 minutes, adding a little hot water only if the rice dries out before it's tender.
Check the chicken reaches 75°C and the rice is tender. Cover off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff lightly to keep the golden crust.

stages.title: Brown the proteins
steps: Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat and brown seasoned chicken pieces for about 5 minutes, until golden.
Add sliced chorizo and cook until its paprika-red oil releases, then transfer both to a plate.

stages.title: Build the rice base
steps: Soften onion and capsicum in the same pan over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until soft, then add garlic and smoked paprika.
Stir in tomatoes and rice, coating grains in the fragrant oil.

stages.title: Simmer without stirring
steps: Pour in hot stock infused with saffron and return chicken and chorizo.
Simmer gently without stirring for 18–22 minutes, adding a little hot water only if rice dries before tender.

stages.title: Rest and serve
steps: Check chicken reaches 75°C and rice is cooked; cover off the heat for 5 minutes.
Fluff only lightly at serving to preserve any golden crust underneath.

batch_04.json::Vietnamese Beef Pho.title: Beef phở
quick_steps: Char the onion and ginger under a hot grill until the edges blacken lightly, then rinse and toast the star anise, cinnamon and cloves in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Cover the bones or oxtail with water, boil for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse the bones and pot.
Return the bones to the pot with the 1 litre of fresh water (plus extra to cover), the charred aromatics and the spices. Simmer gently for 2 hours, skimming off foam.
Strain the broth, then season with the fish sauce and a little salt until savoury but not too salty.
Cook the rice noodles until tender, then divide between warm bowls and top with the thinly sliced steak.
Pour vigorously boiling broth over the beef until it is cooked through, then serve with bean sprouts, basil and lime.

stages.title: Char the aromatics
steps: Char onion halves and ginger under a hot grill until edges blacken lightly.
Rinse charred surfaces briefly and toast whole spices in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.

stages.title: Build the broth
steps: Cover bones with water, boil for 5 minutes, drain and rinse bones and pot to remove impurities.
Add fresh water, aromatics and spices and simmer gently for 2 hours, skimming foam as needed.

stages.title: Strain and season
steps: Strain broth through a fine sieve and discard solids and spent spices.
Season with fish sauce and a little salt until savoury but not overly salty.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Soak or boil noodles as directed until tender, divide between warm bowls and top with thin beef slices.
Pour vigorously boiling broth over beef, ensuring it cooks through, and serve with herbs, sprouts and lime.

batch_04.json::French Beef Bourguignon.title: Beef bourguignon
quick_steps: Pat the beef dry, season, then brown in batches in the olive oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat, about 2 to 3 minutes a side until deeply browned.
Remove the beef and fry the bacon until golden. Soften the onion and carrots, then add the garlic and flour and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the wine slowly, scraping the base, then add the stock, thyme, beef and bacon.
Cover and cook at 160°C for about 2½ hours until the beef is fork-tender, adding a little stock halfway if it looks dry.
Brown the mushrooms separately in a hot pan until golden, then stir into the stew for the last 10 minutes. Adjust the seasoning.

stages.title: Brown beef and bacon
steps: Pat beef dry, season, then brown in batches in olive oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat, about 2 to 3 minutes a side until deeply browned.
Remove beef and fry bacon until golden, leaving some fat in the pot.

stages.title: Build the braise
steps: Soften chopped onion and carrots, then add garlic and flour and stir 1 minute.
Pour in wine slowly, scraping the base, then add stock, thyme, beef and bacon.

stages.title: Slow cook
steps: Cover and cook at 160°C conventional for about 2½ hours until beef is fork-tender.
Check liquid halfway and add a little stock if it becomes dry.

stages.title: Finish mushrooms
steps: Brown mushrooms separately in a hot skillet to prevent them steaming.
Stir into the stew for the last 10 minutes and adjust seasoning before serving.

batch_04.json::Italian Chicken Cacciator.title: Chicken cacciatore
quick_steps: Season the chicken thighs with salt and brown in olive oil over medium-high heat, turning once, about 5 minutes until golden. Set aside.
Cook the sliced onion, capsicum and mushrooms in the same pan until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown. Add the garlic and oregano.
Pour in the wine, scraping the base, and simmer for 3 minutes. Add the tomatoes and stock.
Return the chicken, cover loosely and simmer gently until it reaches 75°C.
Uncover and simmer until the sauce coats a spoon. Season with salt to taste and serve with polenta or crusty bread.

stages.title: Brown chicken
steps: Season thighs with salt and pepper and brown in olive oil over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes until golden.
Turn once to colour both sides, then set aside on a plate.

stages.title: Cook vegetables
steps: Add sliced onion, capsicum and mushrooms to the same pan.
Cook until mushrooms release their liquid and begin to brown, then add minced garlic and oregano.

stages.title: Deglaze and simmer
steps: Pour in wine, scraping the base, and simmer for 3 minutes before adding tomatoes and stock.
Return chicken, cover loosely and simmer gently until chicken reaches 75°C.

stages.title: Reduce and finish
steps: Uncover and simmer until sauce coats a spoon rather than pooling thinly.
Taste for salt and acidity, then serve with polenta or crusty bread.

batch_04.json::Italian Pasta alla Norma.title: Pasta alla Norma
quick_steps: Lightly salt the aubergines, pat dry and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil. Roast at 220°C for 18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and soft.
Gently cook sliced garlic in the remaining olive oil in a skillet over low heat until fragrant but not brown.
Add the canned tomatoes and simmer for 12–15 minutes, breaking them up with a spoon.
Boil the rigatoni in well-salted water until just al dente. Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain.
Toss the pasta, sauce and aubergines together, loosening with pasta water. Fold in torn basil and finish with grated ricotta salata or Parmesan.

batch_04.json::American BBQ Pulled Pork.title: BBQ pulled pork
quick_steps: Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub all over with the brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder and salt.
Place in a snug lidded roasting dish and pour the apple juice around, not over, the meat.
Cover tightly and roast at 150°C for about 4 hours, until fork-tender. Check occasionally that liquid remains in the base.
Rest the pork 10 minutes, remove excess fat and shred. Mix with the warm cooking juices and BBQ sauce until moist but not soupy.
Toast the burger buns cut-side down until lightly golden, then pile in the pulled pork and add coleslaw if you like.

batch_04.json::Turkish Lamb Köfte.title: Lamb köfte
quick_steps: Squeeze the liquid from the grated onion, then mix with the lamb mince, garlic, spices, parsley and salt.
Knead briefly until the mixture holds together, then shape into 12 short oval patties.
Refrigerate the patties on a tray for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a griddle or heavy pan over medium-high heat.
Brush the köfte with olive oil and grill for about 10 minutes, turning every few minutes, until browned and 75°C in the centre.
Rest the köfte for 3 minutes while warming the flatbreads, then serve with tomato, cucumber and yoghurt.

stages.title: Mix and shape
steps: Squeeze excess liquid from grated onion and mix with lamb, garlic, spices, parsley and salt.
Knead briefly until mixture holds together, then form 12 short oval patties.

stages.title: Chill the patties
steps: Place shaped köfte on a tray and refrigerate 15 minutes to firm.
Heat a griddle or heavy pan while the patties chill.

stages.title: Cook thoroughly
steps: Brush köfte lightly with oil and grill over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes, turning every few minutes.
Cook until browned and the centre reaches 75°C for minced meat.

stages.title: Rest and serve
steps: Rest köfte for 3 minutes while warming flatbreads.
Serve with chopped tomato, cucumber and a yoghurt sauce.

batch_04.json::Greek Lemon Potatoes.title: Greek lemon potatoes
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Cut the potatoes into thick wedges and toss in a roasting dish with the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt.
Pour the stock around the potatoes and spread them in a single layer.
Roast for 35–40 minutes, turning once, until tender and most of the liquid has evaporated.
Increase the oven to 230°C, turn the potatoes to expose the pale sides and roast 10–15 minutes more, until golden.
Spoon the pan juices over, taste for salt and serve straight away with extra lemon wedges.

batch_04.json::Japanese Sesame Spinach (.title: Goma-ae (sesame spinach)
quick_steps: Blanch the spinach in a pot of boiling salted water for 30–45 seconds until wilted, then move it straight to cold water.
Squeeze the spinach gently to remove excess water, then cut it into 4 cm lengths.
Roughly grind the sesame seeds in a mortar, leaving some texture. Mix with the soy sauce, sugar and mirin until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the spinach with the dressing just before serving. Taste and add a few drops of soy sauce if needed.

batch_04.json::Indian Cucumber Raita.title: Cucumber raita
quick_steps: Grate the cucumber coarsely and squeeze gently to remove the watery juices, keeping some texture.
Whisk the yoghurt until smooth, then add the cumin, salt and lemon juice. Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Fold in the cucumber, mint and coriander, then refrigerate for at least 10 minutes.
Stir once, scatter over a pinch of cumin and serve cold with flatbread or spicy curries.

batch_04.json::Mexican Refried Beans.title: Refried beans
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the diced onion for about 5 minutes until translucent.
Stir in the garlic and cumin for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the drained beans and 150 ml of the water or stock, scraping up the pan. Simmer gently for about 10 minutes until hot and softened.
Mash with a potato masher, leaving some pieces whole. Add the remaining water or stock a little at a time until creamy and spoonable.
Season with the salt and a squeeze of lime juice. Serve warm with rice, if using.

batch_04.json::Turkish Ezme Salad.title: Ezme salad
quick_steps: Finely dice the tomatoes, capsicum, onion and chilli into very small pieces, then drain off the excess tomato juice.
Whisk the tomato paste, lemon juice, olive oil and pomegranate molasses, then season with a pinch of salt until sharp and savoury.
Mix the vegetables with the dressing and finely chopped parsley, then rest in the fridge for 10 minutes.
Stir, taste and add more lemon if needed. Serve with warm flatbread, if using.

batch_04.json::Chinese Garlic Bok Choy.title: Garlic bok choy
quick_steps: Trim the baby bok choy, wash well between the leaves and halve any larger heads lengthwise.
Heat the neutral oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the finely chopped garlic and cook 20–30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add the bok choy stems and toss for 2 minutes, then add the leafy tops and water.
Cover briefly until the stems are tender-crisp and the leaves have wilted.
Splash in the light soy sauce and sesame oil, toss to coat and serve immediately while the greens are bright.

batch_04.json::French Green Beans Almond.title: Green beans almondine
quick_steps: Boil the beans in salted water for 3–4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Drain, cool in cold water and dry well.
Toast the almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly golden. Tip them out.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook until nutty and pale golden. Add the chopped shallot and cook for 1 minute.
Toss the beans through the butter until hot, then squeeze over the lemon juice.
Scatter with the almonds and serve straight away.

stages.title: Blanch beans
steps: Boil beans in salted water for 3–4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Drain and plunge into cold water, then dry well.

stages.title: Toast almonds
steps: Toast almonds in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until lightly golden, shaking frequently.
Remove as soon as lightly golden so they do not burn.

stages.title: Make browned butter
steps: Melt butter in the pan and cook until it smells nutty and turns pale golden.
Add finely chopped shallot and cook 1 minute, lowering heat if butter darkens.

stages.title: Toss and serve
steps: Add beans and toss until hot, then squeeze in lemon juice.
Scatter toasted almonds over the top and serve straight away.

batch_04.json::American Fluffy Banana Pa.title: Fluffy banana pancakes
quick_steps: Mash the bananas with a fork until mostly smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, vanilla and cooled melted butter.
In another bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
Fold the wet mixture into the dry just until combined; small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered nonstick pan over medium-low heat. Cook 60 ml portions for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes until the centres are set.
Keep the cooked pancakes warm under a clean tea towel while you finish the batch.
Serve with sliced banana and yoghurt or maple syrup.

batch_04.json::Turkish Simit Breakfast S.title: Simit breakfast sandwich
quick_steps: Slice the tomatoes and cucumber thinly, crumble the feta, and split the simit. Toast the simit lightly until just golden.
Heat the olive oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set and the yolks are done how you like.
Layer the tomato, cucumber and feta on the bottom halves of the simit, then top with the eggs and a little chopped parsley.
Close the sandwiches gently and serve straight away while the bread is crisp and the eggs are warm.

stages.title: Prepare fillings
steps: Slice tomatoes and cucumber thinly and crumble feta into a bowl.
Split simit horizontally and toast lightly until just golden, if desired.

stages.title: Cook eggs
steps: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Fry eggs until whites are fully set and yolks reach your preferred doneness.

stages.title: Assemble sandwiches
steps: Layer tomato, cucumber and feta on the bottom halves of the simit.
Add cooked eggs and a little chopped parsley.

stages.title: Serve
steps: Close sandwiches gently so fillings do not spill.
Serve immediately while the bread is crisp and eggs warm.

batch_04.json::Japanese Tamagoyaki Omele.title: Tamagoyaki omelette
quick_steps: Beat the eggs gently with the dashi, soy sauce, sugar and salt. Strain for a smoother texture if you like.
Heat a small nonstick pan over medium-low heat and wipe with a thin film of oil. Pour in a thin layer of egg and tilt to coat.
When the egg is nearly set, roll it toward one edge with a spatula.
Oil the exposed pan, add more egg under the roll and roll again. Repeat until all the egg is used.
Rest the omelette for 2 minutes to finish setting, then slice into thick pieces. Serve warm with rice.

batch_04.json::Sicilian Caponata.title: Sicilian caponata
quick_steps: Dice the aubergines into 2 cm cubes, toss with half the olive oil and roast at 220°C until golden and soft, turning once.
Cook the diced onion and celery in the remaining oil in a wide pan over medium heat for about 8 minutes, until tender but not browned.
Add the tomatoes, olives, rinsed capers, vinegar and sugar, then simmer gently until the tomatoes thicken. Adjust the vinegar or sugar to taste.
Gently fold the roasted aubergine through the sauce, then rest for at least 10 minutes.
Finish with the parsley and serve warm or at room temperature.

stages.title: Brown aubergine
steps: Dice aubergine into 2 cm cubes and toss with half the olive oil.
Roast at 220°C until golden and soft, turning once.

stages.title: Soften vegetables
steps: Heat remaining oil in a wide pan and cook diced onion and celery over medium heat for about 8 minutes.
Stir occasionally until tender but not browned.

stages.title: Build sweet-sour sauce
steps: Add tomatoes, olives, rinsed capers, vinegar and sugar.
Simmer gently until tomatoes thicken and flavours balance, adjusting vinegar or sugar a little at a time.

stages.title: Combine and rest
steps: Fold roasted aubergine through the sauce without crushing the pieces.
Rest at least 10 minutes and finish with parsley; serve warm or at room temperature.

batch_04.json::Italian Polenta with Parm.title: Polenta with Parmesan
quick_steps: Bring the stock and milk to a gentle simmer in a heavy saucepan over medium heat. Season lightly with some of the salt.
Pour in the polenta in a slow stream, whisking continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce the heat to low and cook as the packet directs, about 5 minutes, until thick and tender.
Turn off the heat and stir in the butter and finely grated Parmesan. Loosen with a splash of hot water or milk until it flows slowly from a spoon.
Taste, then adjust the salt and add freshly ground black pepper. Spoon into warm bowls straight away, before it firms up.

batch_04.json::British Scrambled Eggs on.title: Scrambled eggs on toast
quick_steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk, if using, and the salt and a little pepper until just blended.
Toast the sourdough until golden. Warm a nonstick pan over low heat while it toasts, and keep the toast warm.
Melt the butter in the pan over low heat, pour in the eggs and stir slowly with a silicone spatula until curds begin to form.
Lift the pan off the heat briefly if the curds set too fast. Stop while the eggs are still glossy and softly set.
Spoon the eggs over the toast and top with chives and black pepper. Eat straight away.

batch_04.json::Australian Bircher Muesli.title: Bircher muesli
quick_steps: Mix the oats, milk and yoghurt in a bowl, then cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight, until the oats are soft.
Just before serving, grate the apple and toss it with the lemon juice. Wash and drain the berries.
Stir the apple and honey through the soaked oats, adding a splash of milk if it's too thick.
Divide into bowls and top with the berries and chopped almonds. Serve chilled.

batch_04.json::Mexican Breakfast Chilaqu.title: Chilaquiles rojos
quick_steps: Cook the onion, garlic and jalapeño in 1 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat until soft. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Blend the salsa until smooth and season with salt.
Pour the salsa into a wide pan and bring to a gentle simmer. Fold through the tortilla chips for 1–2 minutes, leaving some edges crisp.
Heat the remaining oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Divide the saucy chips between plates and top with the eggs. Scatter over the crumbled cheese and coriander and serve at once.

stages.title: Make red salsa
steps: Cook chopped onion, garlic and jalapeño in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat until soft.
Add tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes, then blend until smooth and season with salt.

stages.title: Warm the chips
steps: Pour salsa into a wide pan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Fold tortilla chips through for 1–2 minutes, leaving some edges crisp.

stages.title: Cook eggs
steps: Heat remaining oil in a separate nonstick pan over medium heat.
Fry eggs until whites are fully set, keeping yolks soft if preferred.

stages.title: Assemble
steps: Divide saucy chips between plates and top each with an egg.
Scatter crumbled cheese and coriander over the top and serve at once.

batch_04.json::Italian Panzanella Salad.title: Panzanella
quick_steps: Tear the day-old bread into bite-size pieces and toast briefly until lightly golden and firm, or skip if already firm.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into irregular chunks and thinly slice the red onion. Salt the tomatoes with the 1/2 tsp salt and collect the juices in the serving bowl.
Whisk the vinegar, olive oil and black pepper, then combine with the tomato juices. Taste and adjust until bright but not harsh.
Toss the bread and vegetables through the dressing and rest for 10–15 minutes.
Fold in the torn basil just before serving.

stages.title: Prepare bread
steps: Tear day-old bread into bite-size pieces and toast briefly until lightly golden if very soft.
The bread should be firm enough to absorb dressing without disintegrating.

stages.title: Chop vegetables
steps: Cut tomatoes and cucumber into irregular chunks and thinly slice red onion.
Salt tomatoes lightly and collect their juices in the serving bowl.

stages.title: Make dressing
steps: Whisk vinegar with olive oil and black pepper, then combine with tomato juices.
Taste and adjust acidity so it tastes bright but not harsh.

stages.title: Toss and rest
steps: Add bread and vegetables to dressing and toss gently.
Rest 10–15 minutes, then fold in torn basil just before serving.

batch_04.json::Japanese Soba Noodle Sala.title: Soba noodle salad
quick_steps: Boil the soba in a pot of water for the time on the packet, then drain and rinse under cold water until cool.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin matchsticks.
Cook the edamame in boiling water until hot, then cool quickly and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and honey, then adjust the balance with a splash of water.
Gently toss the noodles, vegetables and edamame with the dressing.
Scatter over the sesame seeds and serve chilled or at room temperature.

batch_04.json::Mexican Black Bean Quesad.title: Black bean quesadillas
quick_steps: Drain and rinse the black beans, then lightly mash half. Mix with the diced capsicum, cumin, paprika and a squeeze of lime.
Spread the filling over one half of each tortilla, leaving a border. Scatter over the cheddar and fold closed.
Heat a little oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook each quesadilla 2–3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Rest for a minute, then cut into wedges. Serve with salsa, yoghurt or sliced avocado.

batch_04.json::Italian Tiramisu Cups.title: Tiramisu cups
quick_steps: Whip the cold cream with icing sugar and vanilla to soft peaks, then gently fold in the mascarpone until just smooth.
Pour the cooled coffee into a shallow dish. Break the savoiardi to fit four glasses and dip each briefly, about 1 second per side.
Layer the soaked biscuits in the glasses with a layer of mascarpone cream. Repeat the layers and smooth the tops.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, until the layers are set. Dust with cocoa just before serving.

batch_04.json::French Buckwheat Galettes.title: Buckwheat galettes with egg and cheese
quick_steps: Whisk the buckwheat flour, water, 1 egg and salt into a thin, smooth batter. Rest for at least 10 minutes.
Heat a large nonstick frypan over medium heat and brush with butter.
Pour in a thin layer of batter, swirling quickly, and cook until the edges lift.
Flip the galette, crack a filling egg into the centre and scatter the Gruyère and ham around it.
Cover and cook briefly until the egg white is set and the cheese has melted.
Fold the four sides inward, leaving the yolk visible, and serve immediately.

stages.title: Make batter
steps: Whisk buckwheat flour, water, one egg and salt into a thin smooth batter.
Rest for at least 10 minutes to hydrate the flour.

stages.title: Cook galettes
steps: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium and brush with butter.
Pour a thin layer of batter, swirling quickly, and cook over medium heat until edges lift.

stages.title: Add fillings
steps: Flip each galette, crack an egg into the centre and scatter cheese and ham around it.
Cover briefly until egg white is set and cheese melts.

stages.title: Fold and serve
steps: Fold four sides inward to frame the egg while leaving the yolk visible.
Slide onto a plate and serve immediately.

batch_04.json::British Coronation Chicke.title: Coronation chicken sandwiches
quick_steps: Mix the mayonnaise, yoghurt, curry powder, mango chutney and lemon juice until smooth. Taste and adjust the sweetness and acidity.
Shred the chilled cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces, removing any gristle. Fold it through the dressing with the raisins until evenly coated.
Lay the lettuce heart leaves over four slices of wholemeal bread, then spoon the chicken mixture evenly on top.
Top with the remaining bread, press gently and cut into triangles. Serve chilled.

batch_04.json::Middle Eastern Falafel Wr.title: Falafel wraps
quick_steps: Pulse the drained, dry soaked chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, cumin and ground coriander until finely crumbly, not puréed.
Mix in the baking powder, chill for 30 minutes, then press into small, firm patties.
Heat 2 cm oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat to about 175°C. Fry the falafel in batches until deep golden, then drain.
Check the centres are cooked through.
Warm the flatbreads and spread with the tahini and yoghurt mixture.
Fill with falafel, lettuce, tomato and pickles, then roll up tightly.

stages.title: Blend falafel mix
steps: Drain chickpeas soaked overnight and dry thoroughly; do not cook them first.
Pulse with onion, garlic, herbs and spices until finely crumbly, not puréed.

stages.title: Chill and shape
steps: Mix in baking powder and refrigerate the mixture 30 minutes.
Form small compact patties, pressing firmly so they hold together.

stages.title: Fry falafel
steps: Heat 2 cm oil to about 175°C in a deep pan over medium-high heat and fry in batches until deep golden.
Drain on kitchen paper and check centres are cooked through.

stages.title: Build wraps
steps: Warm flatbreads and spread with tahini yoghurt sauce.
Add falafel, lettuce, tomato and pickles and roll tightly.

ingredients: 150 g Greek yoghurt, mixed with the tahini

batch_04.json::American Baked New York C.title: New York cookies
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 180°C conventional and line two baking trays. Beat the softened butter with both sugars until fluffy, then mix in the eggs and vanilla.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt together, then fold into the butter mixture and stir through the chocolate chunks.
Chill the dough for 20 minutes, then scoop into equal mounds on the trays, leaving generous space between them.
Bake for 11–14 minutes, until the edges are golden but the centres still look slightly soft.
Cool on the trays for 10 minutes, then move to a rack.

batch_04.json::Greek Orange and Yoghurt.title: Greek orange and yoghurt cake
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 22 cm round tin. Line the base with baking paper and finely zest the oranges, avoiding the white pith.
Whisk the yoghurt, sugar, eggs, olive oil, vanilla and zest until smooth. Add 80 ml of fresh orange juice and whisk briefly.
Gently fold in the flour and salt until no dry pockets remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 35–40 minutes, until a skewer in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack. Serve with extra yoghurt and a little orange zest.

batch_05.json::Tuscan White Bean and Kal.title: Tuscan white bean and kale soup
quick_steps: Warm the olive oil in a deep pot over medium-low heat. Cook the onion, carrots and celery for 10–12 minutes until tender but not browned.
Add the garlic and rosemary and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the cannellini beans and vegetable stock, then simmer gently for 15 minutes. Mash a ladleful of beans against the pot to thicken the broth.
Add the kale and cook for 5 minutes until soft but still green.
Remove the rosemary and stir in the lemon juice. Season with salt and serve with toasted sourdough, if you like.

batch_04.json::French Crème Brûlée.title: Crème brûlée
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 150°C conventional. Warm the cream and vanilla in a saucepan over low heat until steaming, not boiling, then leave to infuse off the heat for 5 minutes.
Whisk the egg yolks and 80 g caster sugar until combined but not foamy. Slowly whisk in the warm cream, then strain.
Divide the custard among four ramekins in a deep roasting tray. Pour hot water halfway up the ramekins.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, until the edges are set but the centres still wobble.
Cool, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours until cold and firm.
Just before serving, sprinkle the extra caster sugar in thin, even layers and caramelise with a kitchen torch until golden.

batch_04.json::Portuguese Pastéis de Nat.title: Pastéis de nata
quick_steps: Heat oven to 240°C. Roll the puff pastry into a tight log, slice into 12 pieces and press each into a greased muffin tin.
Simmer the sugar, water, cinnamon stick and lemon peel for 3 minutes, then remove the cinnamon and peel.
Whisk the flour with a little cold milk, add the remaining milk and heat until lightly thickened.
Slowly whisk the hot syrup into the milk mixture and cool slightly. Whisk in the egg yolks and strain.
Fill the pastry cases three-quarters full. Bake 12–16 minutes until the pastry is crisp and the custard has dark caramelised spots.
Cool in the tins for 10 minutes, then remove and serve warm.

batch_04.json::Korean Bibimbap Vegetable.title: Bibimbap vegetable bowls
quick_steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs nearly clear, then cook it on the stovetop or in a rice cooker per the packet. Keep it covered and warm.
Julienne the carrots and courgette, and thinly slice the mushrooms. Sauté each separately in the neutral oil in a pan over medium-high heat until tender.
Blanch the spinach briefly, then squeeze it dry.
Mix the gochujang with the sesame oil, soy sauce and a splash of water.
Fry the eggs in a pan over medium heat until the whites are fully set and the yolks are done how you like them.
Divide the rice among bowls, arrange the vegetables in separate sections and top with the eggs. Serve the sauce on the side.

stages.title: Cook rice
steps: Rinse rice until water runs nearly clear and cook according to packet instructions.
Keep covered and warm while preparing toppings.

stages.title: Cook vegetables separately
steps: Julienne carrots and courgette and slice mushrooms thinly.
Sauté each in a little neutral oil over medium-high heat until tender, and blanch spinach briefly before squeezing dry.

stages.title: Make sauce and eggs
steps: Mix gochujang with sesame oil, soy sauce and a splash of water.
Fry eggs over medium heat until whites are fully set and yolks reach desired doneness.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Divide rice among bowls and arrange vegetables in separate colourful sections.
Top with eggs and serve sauce on the side for mixing at the table.

batch_04.json::Indian Masala Dosa with P.title: Masala dosa with potato filling
quick_steps: Boil the peeled potato chunks until tender, then drain and roughly mash.
Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a pan over medium heat. Pop the mustard seeds, then soften the onion, chilli, curry leaves and turmeric, about 5 minutes.
Fold the mashed potato into the spiced onion and season with salt. Add a splash of water if dry, so it's moist but not runny.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and lightly oil it. Spread a ladle of dosa batter thinly and cook until golden underneath and the edges lift.
Fill each dosa with the potato mixture and fold. Serve straight away with sambar or a chutney.

stages.title: Cook potato filling
steps: Boil peeled potato chunks until tender, then drain and roughly mash.
Heat 1 tbsp oil over medium heat, pop mustard seeds, add onion, chilli, curry leaves and turmeric, and soften until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.

stages.title: Finish filling
steps: Fold mashed potatoes into the spiced onion and season with salt.
Add a splash of water if dry; filling should be moist but not runny.

stages.title: Cook thin dosas
steps: Heat a flat nonstick skillet and lightly oil it, then spread a ladle of batter in a thin spiral.
Cook until the underside is golden and edges lift, adding a few drops of oil around the rim.

stages.title: Fill and fold
steps: Place warm potato mixture along the centre of each dosa.
Fold over and serve immediately with sambar or a chutney.

batch_04.json::British Apple Crumble.title: Apple crumble
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Peel, core and slice the apples, toss with the caster sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice, then spread in a baking dish.
Rub the cold butter into the flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the brown sugar and oats, leaving a few buttery clumps.
Scatter the topping over the apples without pressing down. Bake for 30–35 minutes, until golden and the fruit bubbles at the edges.
Rest for 10 minutes so the juices thicken, then serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you like.

stages.title: Prepare fruit
steps: Heat oven to 190°C conventional and peel, core and slice apples evenly.
Toss with caster sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice, then spread in a baking dish.

stages.title: Make crumble topping
steps: Rub cold butter into flour until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in brown sugar and oats, leaving a few larger buttery clumps.

stages.title: Bake until bubbling
steps: Scatter crumble evenly over apples without pressing it down.
Bake 30–35 minutes until topping is golden and fruit bubbles around the edges.

stages.title: Rest and serve
steps: Rest crumble 10 minutes so the juices thicken slightly.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

batch_05.json::Brazilian Black Bean Feij.title: Feijoada
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Brown the pork shoulder and sausage in batches until deeply golden, then set aside.
Cook the onion in the remaining fat over medium heat until soft, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and bay leaves and cook until fragrant.
Return the meats with the drained black beans and water. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover loosely and simmer over low heat for about 75 minutes, until the pork is tender. Top up the water as needed and mash a spoonful of beans into the broth to thicken.
Cook the rice in boiling water for about 12 minutes, until tender, and season the beans to taste.
Serve the feijoada over the rice with orange wedges.

stages.title: Brown the meats
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown pork shoulder and sausage in batches until deeply golden, about 5 minutes per batch.
Transfer to a plate, leaving a little rendered fat in the pot.

stages.title: Build the bean base
steps: Cook chopped onion until soft, then add garlic and bay leaves.
Return meats, add drained beans and water, and bring to a gentle simmer.

stages.title: Simmer until tender
steps: Cover loosely and cook until pork is tender and cooked through, stirring and adding water as needed.
Mash a spoonful of beans into the broth for a thicker texture.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Cook rice in boiling water for about 12 minutes, until tender, while the stew finishes, and taste the beans for seasoning.
Serve feijoada with rice and orange wedges to cut through the richness.

batch_05.json::Indian Chana Masala.title: Chana masala
quick_steps: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat. Cook the onion until golden at the edges, then add the garlic and ginger until fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric and tomatoes. Cook until the tomatoes soften and the mixture is thick and glossy.
Add the chickpeas and water and simmer gently for about 20 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas against the pan to thicken the sauce.
Stir in the garam masala and season with salt. Serve with basmati rice, if you like.

stages.title: Soften onion
steps: Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat and cook onion until golden at the edges.
Add garlic and ginger and stir until fragrant without scorching.

stages.title: Cook spice masala
steps: Add cumin, coriander, turmeric and tomatoes.
Cook until tomatoes soften and the mixture becomes thick and glossy.

stages.title: Simmer chickpeas
steps: Add drained chickpeas and water, then simmer gently for about 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened and flavours combine.
Mash a few chickpeas against the side to naturally thicken the sauce.

stages.title: Finish with garam masala
steps: Stir in garam masala and adjust salt and acidity.
Serve with basmati rice, roti or warm naan.

batch_05.json::Middle Eastern Fattoush S.title: Fattoush salad
quick_steps: Cut the pita into triangles, brush with some of the olive oil and bake at 190°C for 8–10 minutes until crisp and golden.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber, slice the radishes and spring onions, and tear the lettuce. Dry the leaves well.
Whisk the remaining olive oil with the lemon juice, sumac, dried mint and salt. Taste and add more lemon if needed.
Just before serving, toss the vegetables with the dressing, then fold in the toasted pita last to keep it crunchy.

batch_05.json::Korean Cucumber Salad Oi.title: Oi muchim (cucumber salad)
quick_steps: Cut the cucumbers into thin rounds or half-moons, toss with the salt in a colander and leave for 10 minutes.
Rinse lightly if very salty, then pat the cucumbers dry with kitchen paper.
Mix the gochugaru, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sugar and sesame oil, then add the finely sliced spring onion.
Toss the cucumbers in the dressing until evenly coated, then sprinkle with the sesame seeds. Serve while crisp, or chill briefly.

batch_05.json::Greek Gigantes Plaki.title: Gigantes plaki
quick_steps: Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof pan over medium heat. Cook the diced onion and carrots for about 8 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, oregano and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and a splash of water. Simmer for about 8 minutes until slightly reduced, then season with salt and pepper.
Gently fold in the drained butter beans. Bake uncovered at 190°C for about 35 minutes until bubbling and the sauce clings to the beans.
Rest for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens, then scatter with dill and serve warm or at room temperature.

stages.title: Make aromatic base
steps: Heat olive oil in an ovenproof pan over medium heat and soften diced onion and carrots for about 8 minutes, until soft.
Add garlic, oregano and tomato paste and cook for another minute, until fragrant.

stages.title: Build tomato sauce
steps: Add chopped tomatoes and a splash of water and simmer until slightly reduced.
Taste for salt and pepper before adding the beans.

stages.title: Bake beans
steps: Fold in drained butter beans gently and transfer to a baking dish if needed.
Bake uncovered at 190°C until bubbling and the sauce clings to the beans.

stages.title: Rest and finish
steps: Let beans cool for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens.
Scatter with fresh dill and serve warm or at room temperature.

batch_05.json::Chinese Smashed Cucumber.title: Smashed cucumber salad
quick_steps: Smash the cucumbers lengthways with a rolling pin, then tear into irregular bite-sized pieces.
Toss the pieces with a pinch of salt and drain in a colander for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Whisk the rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, chilli oil, sugar and grated garlic. Taste and adjust the acidity or sweetness.
Toss the cucumber in the dressing until evenly coated, then top with the sesame seeds and serve immediately.

batch_05.json::Mexican Elote Street Corn.title: Elote
quick_steps: Husk the corn and pat dry. Heat a barbecue or grill pan to medium-high.
Grill the cobs for about 12 minutes, turning often, until tender and spotted with char. Move away from direct heat if they start to burn.
Stir the mayonnaise and sour cream with a squeeze of lime. Crumble the cheese and chop the coriander.
Brush the hot corn with the creamy mixture, then roll in the cheese.
Dust with chilli powder and finish with lime and coriander.

batch_05.json::Scottish Porridge with St.title: Scottish porridge with stewed apples
quick_steps: Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat. Add the apples, cinnamon and a splash of water, then cover and cook until the apples soften but hold their shape.
Combine the oats, milk, water and salt in a heavy saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer until the porridge is soft and thick, about 8 minutes, adding extra milk if needed.
Divide the porridge among bowls, spoon over the warm apples and drizzle with the maple syrup.

stages.title: Stew apples
steps: Melt butter in a small pan over medium heat and add diced apples, cinnamon and a splash of water.
Cover and cook over medium heat until apples soften but still hold their shape.

stages.title: Start porridge
steps: Combine oats, milk, water and salt in a heavy saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring regularly.

stages.title: Cook until creamy
steps: Reduce heat and simmer oats until soft and thick, adding milk if needed.
Stir frequently to prevent the base catching.

stages.title: Serve warm
steps: Divide porridge among bowls and spoon over warm apples.
Drizzle with maple syrup and serve immediately.

batch_05.json::French Croque Madame.title: Croque madame
quick_steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in the flour and cook for one minute. Whisk in the milk and simmer until smooth and thick, then add the mustard.
Layer the ham and half the grated Gruyère between the sourdough slices. Spread béchamel on top and scatter over the remaining cheese.
Grill the sandwiches on medium until the bread is toasted and the cheese bubbles and the sauce is golden, watching so it doesn't burn.
Fry the eggs in the oil in a pan over medium heat until the whites are fully set. Top each sandwich with an egg and serve hot.

stages.title: Make béchamel
steps: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat, stir in flour and cook for one minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and simmer until smooth and thick, then add mustard.

stages.title: Assemble sandwiches
steps: Layer ham and grated Gruyère between bread slices.
Spread a thin layer of béchamel on top and scatter over remaining cheese.

stages.title: Grill until golden
steps: Place sandwiches under a medium grill until bread is toasted and cheese bubbles.
Watch carefully so the sauce browns without burning.

stages.title: Top with eggs
steps: Fry eggs in a little oil until whites are fully set.
Place one egg on each sandwich and serve hot.

batch_05.json::Greek Spanakopita Triangl.title: Spanakopita triangles
quick_steps: Soften the finely chopped onion in a little of the butter in a pan over medium heat until soft, about 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook until wilted.
Cool the spinach, then squeeze out as much moisture as you can.
Crumble in the feta and stir through the eggs, dill and pepper. Taste before adding salt, as feta is salty.
Cut the filo into long strips and brush lightly with melted butter. Put a spoonful of filling at one end and fold into neat triangles.
Place on a lined tray and brush the tops with the remaining butter. Bake at 190°C for 20–25 minutes until deeply golden, then cool briefly.

stages.title: Cook spinach filling
steps: Soften finely chopped onion in a little butter in a pan over medium heat until soft, then add spinach until wilted.
Cool and squeeze out excess moisture thoroughly.

stages.title: Mix filling
steps: Crumble feta into spinach and stir in eggs, dill and pepper.
Taste before adding salt because feta is already salty.

stages.title: Fold triangles
steps: Cut filo sheets into long strips and brush lightly with melted butter.
Place a spoonful of filling at one end and fold repeatedly into neat triangles.

stages.title: Bake until crisp
steps: Arrange on a lined tray and brush tops with remaining butter.
Bake at 190°C conventional for 20–25 minutes until deeply golden; cool briefly.

batch_05.json::Mexican Chicken Tostadas.title: Chicken tostadas
quick_steps: Brush the tortillas with oil and bake at 200°C until crisp, turning halfway. Cool on a rack so steam doesn't soften them.
Heat the refried beans in a saucepan over medium heat with a splash of water until spreadable.
Warm the chicken separately until steaming hot, then season with a squeeze of lime.
Dice the tomatoes, shred the lettuce and slice the avocado just before serving. Crumble the feta or cotija.
Spread beans on each tortilla, then layer chicken and vegetables. Top with salsa, cheese and lime, and serve immediately.

batch_05.json::Moroccan Carrot and Orang.title: Moroccan carrot and orange salad
quick_steps: Peel the carrots and slice thinly on the diagonal. Simmer in lightly salted water until just tender, then drain and cool slightly.
Peel the oranges, removing the white pith, and cut into segments over a bowl to catch the juice.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, honey, cumin, cinnamon and the reserved orange juice. Taste for a balance of sweet, tart and warm spice.
Gently toss the carrots and orange segments with the dressing.
Scatter the parsley and toasted almonds over the top and serve.

batch_05.json::Chinese Scallion Pancakes.title: Scallion pancakes (cong you bing)
quick_steps: Stir the hot water into the flour until shaggy, then knead until smooth once cool enough to handle. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into four and roll each piece into a thin rectangle.
Brush each rectangle with the sesame oil, then sprinkle with the salt and finely chopped spring onions.
Roll each into a log, coil into a spiral, then flatten gently with a rolling pin.
Heat a thin layer of the neutral oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry the pancakes 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Cut into wedges and serve.

batch_05.json::German Warm Potato Salad.title: Warm potato salad
quick_steps: Cook the whole potatoes in salted water over medium-high heat for about 15 minutes, until tender but not falling apart. Drain, cool briefly, then slice thickly.
Fry the diced bacon in a wide pan over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until golden and crisp. Remove the bacon.
Soften the diced red onion in a little of the bacon fat for about 3 minutes, until soft and translucent.
Add the vinegar, mustard, stock and sugar. Simmer for 2 minutes, scraping up the browned bits, then taste for acidity.
Gently fold the warm potato slices through the dressing until coated. Return the bacon, scatter over the parsley and serve warm.

stages.title: Boil potatoes
steps: Cook whole potatoes in salted water over medium-high heat for about 15 minutes, until tender but not falling apart.
Drain and cool just enough to handle, then slice thickly.

stages.title: Crisp bacon
steps: Fry diced bacon in a wide pan over medium heat until golden and crisp.
Remove bacon and soften diced red onion in a little of the rendered fat for about 3 minutes, until translucent.

stages.title: Make warm dressing
steps: Add vinegar, mustard, stock and sugar to the pan and simmer for 2 minutes, until slightly reduced.
Scrape up any browned bits and taste for acidity.

stages.title: Dress potatoes
steps: Fold warm potato slices into dressing gently until coated.
Return bacon, scatter parsley and serve while warm.

batch_05.json::American Macaroni Salad.title: Macaroni salad
quick_steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for about 10 minutes, until just tender.
Drain, rinse briefly under cold water and let it cool completely.
Finely dice the celery, carrot, red capsicum and spring onions.
Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, sugar, salt and pepper until smooth. Taste for a slightly tangy balance.
Toss the cooled macaroni and vegetables with the dressing until well coated.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, then stir and serve.

batch_05.json::Italian Lemon Ricotta Cak.title: Lemon ricotta cake
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 175°C conventional and line a 20 cm round cake tin. Drain the ricotta briefly and zest the lemons finely.
Beat the softened butter and caster sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the ricotta, vanilla, lemon zest and lemon juice until just combined.
Sift over the flour and baking powder and fold gently. Spoon into the tin.
Bake for 40–45 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then move to a rack. Dust with icing sugar once completely cool, if you like.

batch_05.json::American Banana Bread.title: Banana bread
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 175°C conventional and line a loaf tin. Mash the bananas until mostly smooth and stir in the melted, cooled butter.
Whisk in the brown sugar, eggs and vanilla until just combined.
Fold in the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cinnamon and salt until no dry flour remains.
Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the centre springs back and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack before slicing.

batch_05.json::American Breakfast Burrit.title: Breakfast burritos
quick_steps: Cook the diced potatoes in the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat until golden and tender, about 15–18 minutes. Add the capsicum for the last 5 minutes and season with salt.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook in a nonstick pan over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, folding until just set but still soft.
Warm the tortillas until flexible. Fill with the potatoes, eggs, warmed black beans, cheddar, salsa and avocado.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Toast seam-side down in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly crisp, then serve.

stages.title: Crisp potatoes
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook small potato cubes until golden and tender.
Add diced capsicum for the final five minutes and season lightly.

stages.title: Scramble eggs
steps: Beat eggs with a pinch of salt and cook gently in a nonstick pan for 2 to 3 minutes.
Fold until just set and remove from heat before they dry out.

stages.title: Fill tortillas
steps: Warm tortillas briefly to make them flexible.
Divide potatoes, eggs, warmed beans, cheese, salsa and avocado among them.

stages.title: Roll and toast
steps: Fold the sides inward and roll tightly from the bottom.
Toast seam-side down in a dry pan until lightly crisp, then serve.

batch_05.json::American Breakfast Burrit.hand_fixed: drift judge flag (both judge versions), fixed by hand 2026-11-20

batch_05.json::Vietnamese Lemongrass Por.title: Lemongrass pork bowls
quick_steps: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice, toss with the pork and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
Cook the rice on medium heat per the packet until tender, then leave it covered to rest.
Julienne the carrot and thinly slice the cucumber.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan over high heat. Sear the pork in small batches, 2 to 3 minutes each, until browned and cooked through with no pink.
Fluff the rice into bowls and top with the hot pork, cucumber, carrot and extra lime, keeping the vegetables separate.

stages.title: Marinate pork
steps: Mix minced tender lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Toss with thin pork slices and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.

stages.title: Cook rice and vegetables
steps: Rinse and cook rice on medium heat according to the packet until tender, then leave covered to rest.
Julienne carrot and slice cucumber thinly for a crisp topping.

stages.title: Sear pork
steps: Heat oil in a heavy pan over high heat until hot and cook pork in small batches, 2 to 3 minutes per batch.
Let slices brown before turning and cook until browned and cooked through with no pink remaining.

stages.title: Assemble bowls
steps: Fluff rice into bowls and top with hot lemongrass pork.
Add cucumber, carrot and extra lime, keeping crunchy vegetables separate.

batch_05.json::Thai Mango Sticky Rice.title: Mango sticky rice
quick_steps: Rinse the glutinous rice until the water runs mostly clear, then soak in cool water for at least 2 hours and drain well.
Line a steamer with muslin, spread the rice in an even layer and steam over simmering water for 20–25 minutes, until tender and translucent.
Warm the coconut milk, sugar and salt in a pan over low heat until the sugar dissolves. Set a little aside for serving.
Fold most of the coconut mixture into the hot rice, then cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Peel and slice the mangoes. Serve with the rice, reserved coconut sauce and sesame seeds.

batch_05.json::Spanish Basque Burnt Chee.title: Basque burnt cheesecake
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 220°C conventional. Line a 20 cm springform tin with two large crumpled parchment sheets, letting the paper stand above the rim.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar until completely smooth. Add the eggs one at a time.
Mix in the cream, vanilla, salt and sifted flour until smooth.
Pour the batter into the tin and bake for 35–40 minutes, until deeply browned on top with a centre that still wobbles.
Cool at room temperature until no longer hot, then refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Remove the parchment and slice with a warm knife.

batch_05.json::Greek Baklava.title: Baklava
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 175°C conventional. Mix the chopped walnuts and almonds with the cinnamon, and butter a rectangular baking dish.
Layer half the filo in the dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter. Scatter over the nut mixture, then top with the remaining buttered filo.
Score the top into diamonds, then bake for 40–45 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, simmer the sugar, water, honey and lemon peel in a saucepan over medium heat for 10 minutes, then cool slightly.
Pour the warm syrup gradually over the hot baklava and leave until absorbed.

stages.title: Prepare nut filling
steps: Heat oven to 175°C conventional and finely chop the walnuts and almonds without turning them to powder.
Mix the walnuts and almonds with cinnamon and butter a rectangular baking dish.

stages.title: Layer filo
steps: Lay half the filo sheets in the dish, brushing each lightly with melted butter.
Scatter nut mixture evenly, then layer remaining filo with butter between sheets.

stages.title: Cut and bake
steps: Score the top into diamonds before baking so the crisp pastry does not shatter later.
Bake 40–45 minutes until deeply golden and crisp.

stages.title: Pour cooled syrup
steps: Simmer sugar, water, honey and lemon peel for 10 minutes, then cool slightly.
Pour warm syrup over hot baklava gradually and let stand until absorbed.

batch_05.json::Portuguese Arroz Doce.title: Arroz doce
quick_steps: Simmer the rice with the water, lemon peel, cinnamon stick and salt over low heat for about 20 minutes, until most of the water is absorbed.
Warm the milk separately, then add it gradually to the rice. Cook gently for about 25 minutes, until the grains are tender and the pudding is creamy.
Stir in the sugar. Mix the egg yolks with a little warm pudding in a bowl.
Return the yolk mixture to the pot over low heat and stir for a few minutes, until thickened. Don't let it boil.
Remove the cinnamon stick and lemon peel, divide into bowls and dust with cinnamon. Serve warm or chilled.

batch_05.json::Georgian Khachapuri Chees.title: Khachapuri cheese bread
quick_steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, water and salt into a soft dough, then knead with the oil until smooth and elastic.
Cover and leave somewhere warm until doubled, about 1 hour. Meanwhile, mix the crumbled feta with the grated mozzarella.
Divide the dough into two ovals and roll the long edges inward to make rims. Fill with the cheese and pinch the ends into points.
Bake at 220°C for about 18 minutes, until golden and bubbling. Crack an egg into each centre for the last few minutes, until the whites are set.

batch_05.json::Japanese Matcha Panna Cot.title: Matcha panna cotta
quick_steps: Soak the gelatin leaves in cold water until soft. Sift the matcha into a small bowl to remove any lumps.
Warm the cream, milk, sugar and vanilla in a pan over low heat until steaming but not boiling, about 8 minutes.
Whisk a little warm cream into the matcha to make a smooth paste, then return it to the pan.
Take off the heat and stir in the squeezed gelatin until completely dissolved.
Divide among four glasses and refrigerate at least 4 hours, until softly set.
Thinly slice the strawberries, pat dry and place on top just before serving.

batch_05.json::Australian Lamingtons.title: Lamingtons
quick_steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20 cm square tin. Cream the butter and caster sugar, then beat in the eggs.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, milk and vanilla. Bake until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool the sponge completely, then chill briefly until firm. Cut into 16 even squares with a serrated knife.
Whisk the icing sugar and cocoa with enough warm water to make a smooth, pourable glaze. Tip the desiccated coconut into a shallow dish.
Dip each square in the glaze and let the excess drip off. Roll in the coconut and set on a rack until the coating sets.

batch_05.json::Indian Gajar Halwa.title: Gajar halwa
quick_steps: Simmer the carrots and milk in a wide heavy pan over medium-low heat, stirring often, for about 35 minutes until the carrots soften and the milk mostly reduces.
Stir in the ghee and sugar and cook about 12 minutes, stirring as it thickens, until thick.
Add the cardamom and raisins and cook about 5 minutes until glossy and spoonable. Add a little more sugar only if needed.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan over medium heat until lightly golden, then scatter over the warm halwa and serve in small bowls.

batch_05.json::Egyptian Koshari.title: Koshari
quick_steps: Simmer the lentils until tender and cook the rice to packet directions. Boil the macaroni in salted water until al dente.
Fry the sliced onions in oil over medium heat until deep golden. Drain on paper and reserve a little of the oil.
Cook the garlic and cumin in the reserved oil over medium heat for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and vinegar.
Simmer the sauce until thick and tangy, then adjust the salt.
Layer the rice, lentils and macaroni in bowls. Spoon over the tomato sauce and top with the crisp onions.

stages.title: Cook grains
steps: Simmer lentils until tender and cook rice separately according to packet directions.
Boil macaroni in salted water until al dente.

stages.title: Crisp onions
steps: Thinly slice onions and fry in oil over medium heat until deep golden.
Drain on paper and reserve a little flavoured oil.

stages.title: Make tomato sauce
steps: Cook garlic and cumin in reserved oil for 1 minute until fragrant, then add tomatoes and vinegar.
Simmer until thick and tangy, adjusting salt.

stages.title: Layer and serve
steps: Layer rice, lentils and macaroni in bowls.
Spoon over tomato sauce and finish with crisp onions.

batch_05.json::Polish Pierogi Ruskie.title: Pierogi ruskie
quick_steps: Mix the flour, warm water, egg and salt into a supple dough, then knead until smooth and rest it, covered.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain and mash them.
Fry the chopped onions in the butter over medium heat for about 8 minutes, until soft and golden. Mix half through the mash with the cottage cheese.
Roll the dough thinly, cut rounds with a glass, then fill, fold into half-moons and seal the edges firmly.
Boil the pierogi in salted water until they float, then cook for another 2 minutes.
Drain and toss with the remaining onions.

stages.title: Make dough
steps: Mix flour, water, egg and salt into a supple dough.
Knead until smooth and cover to rest.

stages.title: Prepare filling
steps: Boil potatoes until tender, drain and mash thoroughly.
Fry chopped onion in butter over medium heat for about 8 minutes, until soft and golden, then combine half with potato and cheese.

stages.title: Fill dumplings
steps: Roll dough thinly and cut rounds with a glass.
Add filling, fold into half-moons and seal edges firmly.

stages.title: Boil and serve
steps: Boil pierogi in salted water until they float and cook another two minutes.
Drain and toss with remaining buttery onions.

batch_05.json::Persian Zereshk Polo with.title: Zereshk polo with chicken
quick_steps: Season the chicken with turmeric and salt. Brown in the oil in a pan over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until golden.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened.
Add 200 ml water, cover and simmer on low until the chicken reaches 75°C. Uncover and reduce the sauce if watery.
Rinse the basmati and cook until just tender. Bloom the saffron in warm water and fold it through a portion of the rice.
Warm the barberries with the butter and sugar over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until glossy, without burning.
Serve the chicken with the rice, topped with the barberries and saffron rice.

stages.title: Brown chicken
steps: Season chicken with turmeric and salt and brown in oil in a pan over medium-high heat until golden, about 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Add sliced onion and cook until softened.

stages.title: Braise gently
steps: Add 200 ml water, cover and simmer until chicken reaches 75°C.
Reduce sauce uncovered if watery.

stages.title: Steam saffron rice
steps: Rinse and cook basmati rice until just tender.
Bloom saffron in warm water and fold into a portion of rice.

stages.title: Warm barberries
steps: Briefly warm barberries in butter and sugar without burning.
Serve chicken with rice and scatter barberries and saffron rice over the top.

batch_05.json::Danish Æbleskiver Pancake.title: Æbleskiver (pancake balls)
quick_steps: Whisk the egg yolks with the buttermilk and melted butter, then fold in the flour, sugar, baking powder and cardamom.
Beat the egg whites to soft peaks and fold them gently through the batter.
Heat an oiled æbleskiver pan over medium heat and fill each hollow three-quarters full with batter.
Cook in batches, about 5 minutes each, turning the balls gradually with a skewer until golden and cooked in the middle.
Dust with icing sugar and serve straight away with jam, if using.

stages.title: Mix batter
steps: Separate eggs and whisk yolks with buttermilk and melted butter.
Fold in flour, sugar, baking powder and cardamom.

stages.title: Whip whites
steps: Beat egg whites to soft peaks.
Fold gently into batter to keep it airy.

stages.title: Cook in mould
steps: Heat an æbleskiver pan over medium heat, oil it with the vegetable oil and fill each hollow three-quarters full.
Turn balls gradually with a skewer until golden and cooked in the middle.

stages.title: Serve warm
steps: Transfer to a plate and dust with icing sugar.
Serve immediately with berry jam.

batch_05.json::Danish Æbleskiver Pancake.hand_fixed: drift judge flag, fixed by hand (approved 2026-11-20)

batch_05.json::Filipino Turon Banana Rol.title: Turon (banana rolls)
quick_steps: Peel the bananas and halve each lengthwise. Mix the brown sugar and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Roll each banana piece in the sugar mixture and place on a spring roll wrapper.
Fold the sides in and roll tightly, sealing the edge with a little water.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the rolls in batches for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until the wrappers are crisp and golden.
